articles.title: When More Metadata Misleads: Probing Field-Level Grounding in LLM-Generated Museum Descriptions
articles.abstract: Metadata-conditioned generation is often framed as a data-to-text task in which additional input fields should improve grounding. Museum description generation challenges this assumption because catalogue records are heterogeneous, partially visual, and unevenly documented across geographic regions. We study how metadata composition shapes the generation of artefact descriptions through a two-phase framework. Phase 1 analyses natural metadata variation in a large museum collection, where field count, field type, image availability, and Place co-vary. Phase 2 introduces controlled field probes that hold object identity fixed while varying metadata quantity, field type, and image access. Our results show that metadata quantity alone does not explain generation behaviour. Field type determines whether models ground, omit, or infer information, while images can both support visual grounding and increase unsupported interpretation. More broadly, our findings show that metadata-conditioned data-to-text evaluation should assess field- and claim-level support, rather than relying only on aggregate input coverage or reference similarity.
articles.titleCn: 当更多元数据误导时：探究LLM生成博物馆描述中的字段级接地
articles.abstractCn: 元数据条件生成通常被框定为数据到文本的任务，其中额外的输入字段应有助于增强关联性。博物馆描述生成挑战了这一假设，因为目录记录具有异构性、部分视觉化以及地理区域间记录不均等。我们通过一个两阶段框架研究元数据构成如何塑造文物描述的生成。第一阶段分析大型博物馆馆藏中自然元数据的变异，其中字段数量、字段类型、图像可用性和地理位置协同变化。第二阶段引入受控字段探针，在固定物体身份的同时，变化元数据数量、字段类型和图像访问权限。我们的结果表明，仅元数据数量无法解释生成行为。字段类型决定了模型是关联信息、省略信息还是推断信息，而图像既能支持视觉关联性，又能增加无根据的解释。更广泛地说，我们的发现表明，元数据条件下的数据到文本评估应评估字段和声明级别的支持，而不仅依赖于总输入覆盖率或参考相似性。

articles.title: Prompting Strategy Effects Depend on the Judge: A Multilingual Study of LLM-as-a-Judge Robustness
articles.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation is increasingly applied to multilingual tasks, yet prompting strategies such as Chain-of-Thought and Role Conditioning are recommended based solely on English benchmarks. Whether their effectiveness transfers across judge models and languages remains unknown: prompt-sensitivity studies are largely English-centric, while existing multilingual judge studies fix the prompt template. In this work, we address this gap by measuring this interaction through a benchmark of 9 prompting strategies, 4 open-weight judges, 27 languages, and 4 tasks across 13 datasets, yielding over 1M pointwise scores on gold-reference outputs, validated against human judgments. We find that prompting strategies are not transferable: the choice of the judge model dominates the choice of prompting strategy, strategy effects reverse direction across judges, and stability degrades in low-resource languages, where these effects are concealed by aggregate reporting. These findings show that prompting effects in multilingual evaluation are conditioned on the judge, task, and language. Consequently, prompting strategies should be validated for the intended evaluation setting, and cross-study comparisons should account for both judge and prompt configuration.
articles.titleCn: 提示策略的效果取决于评判者：一项关于将LLM作为评判者鲁棒性的多语言研究
articles.abstractCn: LLM作为裁判的评估方法越来越多地应用于多语言任务，然而像思维链和角色条件等提示策略仅基于英语基准提出。它们的有效性是否能在不同裁判模型和语言间迁移尚不明确：提示敏感性研究主要集中于英语，而现有的多语言裁判研究则固定了提示模板。在本工作中，我们通过一个包含9种提示策略、4个开放权重裁判、27种语言和13个数据集上的4种任务基准来测量这种交互作用，在黄金参考输出上产生了超过100万个逐点评分，并与人工判断进行验证。我们发现提示策略是不可迁移的：裁判模型的选择主导了提示策略的选择，策略效果在不同裁判间方向反转，稳定性在低资源语言中退化，而这些效果被汇总报告所掩盖。这些结果表明，多语言评估中的提示效果取决于裁判、任务和语言。因此，提示策略应在预期的评估环境中进行验证，跨研究比较应同时考虑裁判和提示配置。

articles.title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
articles.abstract: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.
articles.titleCn: 超越观看与搜索：针对以视频为中心的深度研究报告的智能体基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究代理将开放网络证据整合成长篇报告，但当前基准测试并未评估以源视频为中心的研究。我们引入了以视频为中心的深度研究报告生成任务。给定一个视频和用户请求，代理识别研究问题，检索外部多模态证据，并生成与相关视频片段链接的交互式报告。这项任务具有直接的实用价值，因为它帮助用户定位相关片段、验证声明、复现演示步骤，并从视频内容中做出明智决策。我们提出了基于技能的工作流程和OmniDR-Bench，用于此任务。为进行评估，我们提出了Omni原子评分树（Omni-ARTs）。每棵树包含三个维度、23个共享方向和任务特定的原子二元标准。这些方向测试视听基础、多模态证据使用和交互式呈现。审计评分树构建（ARC）通过独立证据收集、自动检查、行为校准和迭代人工审查来构建这些树。OmniDR-Bench包含19个现实世界子类别中的50个中文和英文任务。它包含6,414个标准。在18个代理配置中，最佳系统的得分为100分中的63.3分。当前代理仍需更广泛的内容覆盖范围、跨模态更强的因果和逻辑分析，以及更准确的引用支持。我们进一步分析了模型、工具、技能配置、视频类别和研究轨迹。代码和数据已发布在https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench。

articles.title: Prompt Sensitivity in Tool-Augmented Model Comparisons
articles.abstract: Language models are compared on question-answering benchmarks that pose each question in one wording, and a reworded question can change which of two models scores higher. We ask whether giving the models tools makes such comparisons more stable. An accuracy gain cannot answer this, because tools change several steps between the question and the scored answer at once. We propose a matched protocol that separates those steps: the answer readout, reasoning, the decision to call, the tool's answer, and the report supplied without a call. We apply it to six open models in five domains under five wordings. We find that tools raise accuracy where a program answers the question and widen the wording sensitivity of many pairwise comparisons. The widening follows how often a model calls, and call frequency follows the wording for some models and not others. It also depends on the interface and the instructions: a native tool-calling interface and a second tool description leave no detected widening in molecules, and sensitivity persists where tools return intermediate results. These findings show that deterministic reports do not guarantee stable comparisons. We recommend reporting call frequency and comparison stability under several wordings beside accuracy.
articles.comment: 9 pages plus 8 pages of supplementary material; 2 figures and 4 tables in the main text, 2 figures and 5 tables in the supplement
articles.titleCn: 工具增强模型比较中的提示敏感性
articles.abstractCn: 在问答基准测试中，语言模型被比较，每个问题都使用一种表述方式，而重新表述的问题可能会改变两个模型中哪个得分更高。我们询问是否为模型提供工具可以使这种比较更加稳定。准确率的提升无法回答这个问题，因为工具会同时改变问题到得分答案之间的多个步骤。我们提出了一种匹配协议，将那些步骤分开：答案读取、推理、调用决策、工具的答案以及未调用时提供的报告。我们将其应用于五个领域中六个开源模型，在五种表述方式下。我们发现工具提高了程序回答问题的准确率，并扩大了许多成对比较的表述敏感性。这种扩大遵循模型调用的频率，而调用频率对某些模型遵循表述方式，对另一些模型则不遵循。它还取决于接口和指令：一个本地工具调用接口和第二个工具描述在分子领域没有检测到扩大，并且在工具返回中间结果时敏感性仍然存在。这些发现表明，确定性报告并不能保证比较的稳定性。我们建议在报告准确率的同时，报告在不同表述方式下的调用频率和比较稳定性。

articles.title: Mixing Matters: Evidence Position Bias Across Sequence Mixers in Long-Context Question Answering
articles.abstract: Long-context models often use answer-bearing evidence less effectively when it appears away from a prompt boundary. We compare this position bias across Transformer, state-space, and hybrid Mamba architectures by moving one gold document through a fixed set of nine distractors. The evaluated Transformers show a beginning advantage that the evaluated state-space models lack, while both families favor evidence near the end. A matched pure-versus-hybrid Mamba comparison points in the same direction but remains statistically uncertain. The family difference appears among models that can answer the task. Transformer primacy reappears on synthetic retrieval, where state-space ceiling prevents a family comparison. A corpus swap within one state-space architecture changes overall accuracy without a detectable change in curve shape. Prompt changes can create or nearly remove a beginning advantage. Position remains decodable across architectures even when response curves differ, and attention concentration near initial tokens covaries with beginning sensitivity in the tested Transformer family. These exploratory results show that effective context use depends on the evaluated architecture family, capability, task, and prompt, without isolating the sequence mixer as the sole cause.
articles.comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM), NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages. Code: https://github.com/beingamanforever/Mixing-Matters
articles.titleCn: 混合问题：长上下文问答中序列混合器中的证据位置偏差
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文模型在答案证据远离提示边界时，往往无法有效利用该证据。我们通过将一个金文档在固定的一组九个干扰文档中移动，比较了Transformer、状态空间和混合Mamba架构中的位置偏差。评估的Transformer模型显示出起始优势，而评估的状态空间模型则缺乏这种优势，但两种模型都倾向于在末尾附近寻找证据。一个匹配的纯Mamba与混合Mamba对比同样指向这一方向，但结果在统计上仍不确定。在能够回答任务的模型中，Transformer的优势重新出现，而状态空间模型的极限阻止了家族间的比较。在一个状态空间架构中进行的语料库交换改变了整体准确率，但曲线形状未出现可检测的变化。提示的改变可以创造或几乎消除起始优势。即使响应曲线不同，位置仍然可以在不同架构中解码，并且测试的Transformer家族中初始标记附近的注意力集中与起始敏感性相关。这些探索性结果表明，有效的上下文使用取决于评估的架构家族、能力、任务和提示，而没有将序列混合器作为唯一原因进行隔离。

articles.title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
articles.abstract: Our previous analysis found that a model's native hashed N-gram table is where continual updates disturb the base least, but its writes needed backpropagation and changed the pretrained table. We present Delta N-gram, a forward-only write path into that table. The pretrained table T^0 is never modified. Evidence is written into a sparse patch Δon the rows it addresses: a 4.1M-parameter writer emits a target and a gate per (position, hash head) event, and a block-averaged delta rule keeps each row a convex combination of its old value and the gated targets. The writer is trained offline on raw text with the pretraining objective; at use time writing takes forward passes only, and clearing Δrestores the original model. A 0.6B prototype trained to answer questions keeps 16/16 facts after a second write; online gradient writes keep 2--4/16. We study two writers: a plain writer that encodes evidence with the T^0-only model, and a delta writer that reads its current memory while encoding. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the plain writer's memory is document-specific: on 64 held-out news events it lowers continuation NLL by 0.068 nats/token against empty memory and by 0.024 against another document's memory, and 0.063 and 0.013 after 16 intervening articles. The delta writer's memory is more document-specific and keeps more of it under distraction (70% vs 54%). Over 35,000 writes on our previous seven-task chain both writers stay stable and the delta writer drifts less (layer-2 math drift 176% vs 188%); later accuracy changes by -0.26/-0.52pp (-7.29pp for gradient updates) and small-k_i drift is 17.9/17.5% (39.2%). Acquisition is negative, and general-input drift reaches 32.8% (20.75%): format rows read by every example grow to 4--12 times their pretrained norm. Zeroing eight such rows removes over 98% of layer-2 drift on math inputs, together with their NLL gain.
articles.comment: 33 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables, 2 algorithms. Follow-up to arXiv:2610.14921. Code: https://github.com/af-74413592/delta-ngram
articles.titleCn: Delta N-gram：仅向前持续写入语言模型的本地N-gram内存
articles.abstractCn: 我们之前的分析发现，模型的本地哈希N-gram表是持续更新干扰最小的位置，但其写入需要反向传播并改变了预训练表。我们提出了Delta N-gram，这是一种仅向前写入路径，直接写入该表。预训练表T^0从未被修改。证据被写入它所指向的稀疏补丁Δ中：一个4.1M参数的写入器为每个（位置，哈希头）事件发出目标和门控，块平均增量规则使每一行成为其旧值和门控目标的凸组合。写入器在原始文本上使用预训练目标离线训练；使用时写入仅进行前向传递，清除Δ可恢复原始模型。一个0.6B原型训练用于回答问题，在第二次写入后仍保留16/16个事实；在线梯度写入保留2--4/16。我们研究了两种写入器：一种普通写入器，仅使用T^0模型编码证据，另一种增量写入器，在编码时读取其当前内存。在Qwen3.8-Flash-Next上，普通写入器的内存是文档特定的：在64个保留的新闻事件上，它相对于空内存将延续NLL降低0.068 nats/token，相对于另一文档的内存降低0.024，16篇文章后分别降低0.063和0.013。增量写入器的内存更具文档特定性，在干扰下保留更多（70% vs 54%）。在我们之前的七任务链上超过35,000次写入，两种写入器都保持稳定，增量写入器漂移更小（层2数学漂移176% vs 188%）；后期准确率变化为-0.26/-0.52pp（梯度更新为-7.29pp），小-k_i漂移为17.9/17.5%（39.2%）。获取为负，一般输入漂移达到32.8%（20.75%）：每个示例读取的格式行增长到其预训练规范的4--12倍。将八行这样的行置零，可消除数学输入上超过98%的层2漂移，连同它们的NLL增益。

articles.title: Through a PRISM, Clearly: Step-Sequence Reasoning for Mistake Recognition in Procedural Videos
articles.abstract: Procedural mistake recognition requires identifying deviations from valid multi-step activities. We study post-completion recognition from videos with benchmark-provided step boundaries. We introduce PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling), which grounds video segments in language and maps their descriptions to procedural states using a lightweight hidden Markov model trained on correct executions. Reference alignment and semantic checks identify errors in step content and order. To support evaluation across heterogeneous benchmarks, we map dataset-specific annotations to four edit-based error types: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Across three benchmarks, we compare gold and VLM-generated descriptions in raw, semantic-role, and action-object forms. Decoder controls show consistent gains from the trained local decoder over nearest-candidate matching, with additional, dataset-dependent benefits from sequence decoding. Semantic role labeling improves Any-F1 in all six matched grounded comparisons, although the gains vary across datasets and do not translate into uniform improvements under separate configuration selection. These results establish language grounding as an effective interface for explicit procedural mistake reasoning and characterize the contributions of representation and decoding.
articles.titleCn: 通过棱镜，清晰：步骤序列推理用于程序性视频中的错误识别
articles.abstractCn: 程序性错误识别需要识别有效多步活动中的偏差。我们研究了从具有基准提供的步骤边界的视频中进行完成后的识别。我们引入了PRISM（基于可解释语义建模的程序性错误识别），该模型将视频片段置于语言中，并使用在正确执行上训练的轻量级隐马尔可夫模型将其描述映射到程序状态。参考对齐和语义检查用于识别步骤内容和顺序中的错误。为了支持跨异构基准的评估，我们将数据集特定的标注映射到四种基于编辑的错误类型：插入、删除、替换和转置。在三个基准上，我们比较了金标准和VLM生成的描述在原始、语义角色和动作-对象形式中的表现。解码器控制显示出从训练的本地解码器到最近候选匹配的持续增益，并从序列解码中获得额外的、依赖于数据集的优势。语义角色标注在所有六个匹配的接地比较中提高了Any-F1，尽管增益在不同数据集中有所不同，并且在单独的配置选择下并未转化为统一的改进。这些结果确立了语言接地作为显式程序性错误推理的有效接口，并描述了表示和解码的贡献。

articles.title: A Grammar of French Civil Cassation: A Ground-Level Dataset and Tool
articles.abstract: This paper presents a dataset of 121,536 ground-reasons pairs across 86,464 rulings of the five civil chambers of the French Court of Cassation (2016-2025). An appeal on points of law cannot itself be appealed and often decides a case for good. Understanding how the Court rules is thus crucial and can help lawyers who draft those appeals. Inside a ruling, every ground of appeal (a distinct legal complaint against the appealed decision) has its own answer from the Court. This answer is called the reasons and it belongs to one of a few doctrinal families. Using a deterministic pipeline, we pair each ground with its reasons and attach the pair to its family, according to the established French taxonomy. We obtain a descriptive grammar of civil cassation that shows which grounds succeed, which legal texts they refer to, and how both evolve over the decade. We release the dataset, the code and an interactive consultation tool.
articles.comment: Accepted at JURIX 2026 (39th International Conference on Legal Knowledge and Information Systems)
articles.titleCn: 法国民事最高法院判例法：基础层面的数据集和工具
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了法国最高法院民事审判庭（2016-2025年）86,464份裁决中的121,536组地面理由对。法律问题的上诉本身不能再次上诉，并且通常能最终决定案件。因此，理解法院的裁决方式至关重要，有助于起草上诉的律师。在一份裁决中，每个上诉理由（针对被上诉决定的独立法律投诉）都会收到法院的单独答复。这个答复被称为理由，属于少数几个教义家族之一。我们使用确定性流程，根据法国既定的分类法，将每个理由与其理由配对，并将其附加到其家族中。我们获得了一个民事非常上诉的描述性语法，展示了哪些理由成功，它们参考了哪些法律文本，以及它们在十年间如何演变。我们发布了数据集、代码和交互式咨询工具。

articles.title: Learning What to Ask for Tomorrow: Active Preference Acquisition for Long-Term Personalized Web Agents
articles.abstract: Web agents increasingly serve the same user across repeated online tasks such as booking travel, shopping, and scheduling, so their long-term usefulness depends on how well they know the user's preferences. Passive memory and personalization methods cannot obtain preferences the user never reveals, and clarification methods that value a question by its benefit to the current task overlook the benefit of reusing the answer in later tasks. We study Active Preference Acquisition (APA): which missing preferences are worth the cost of asking? We define the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of a missing preference as its expected cumulative utility gain over future tasks minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking, and select questions under a per-interaction budget. We characterize when cumulative reuse justifies acquisition despite insufficient single-task benefit, and evaluate this regime with an initial-profile diagnostic. APA computes the counterfactual gain of each candidate preference on public task prototypes with the agent's own task solver and aggregates it by the expected reuse of each task family. We evaluate it on ActiveWebPref, a controlled longitudinal benchmark with hidden but queryable user profiles and exact task utilities. At a horizon of 20 tasks, 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable missing preferences are amortization-dependent; APA acquires 80.3% of them, whereas current-task value of information acquires 5.1%. Under per-user asking-cost caps matched to APA's realized expenditure, APA achieves higher net utility than four heuristic selection baselines. In our cost setting, asking about every unknown preference yields lower net utility than not asking, while APA recovers 84.2% of its utility gain with 27.6% of its questions. The value of acquiring a user preference should account for its reuse across future tasks, not only its benefit to the task at hand.
articles.titleCn: 学习明天要询问什么：长期个性化网络代理的主动偏好获取
articles.abstractCn: 网络代理越来越多地在预订旅行、购物和安排日程等重复性在线任务中为同一用户提供服务，因此它们的长远效用取决于对用户偏好的了解程度。被动记忆和个性化方法无法获取用户未透露的偏好，而重视当前任务收益来评估问题的澄清方法则忽略了在后续任务中重用答案的收益。我们研究了主动偏好获取（APA）：哪些缺失的偏好值得询问的成本？我们将缺失偏好的预期个性化价值（PPV）定义为未来任务中预期累积效用收益减去询问的努力和披露风险成本，并在每次交互的预算下选择问题。我们描述了当累积重用足以证明获取价值时的情况，尽管单任务收益不足，并使用初始配置诊断评估此机制。APA使用代理自己的任务求解器在公共任务原型上计算每个候选偏好的反事实收益，并根据每个任务系列的预期重用进行聚合。我们在ActiveWebPref上评估它，这是一个具有隐藏但可查询用户配置文件和精确任务效用的受控纵向基准。在20个任务的时间范围内，34.4%的预算可行的有价值缺失偏好依赖于摊销；APA获取了其中的80.3%，而当前任务的信息价值仅获取了5.1%。在匹配APA实际支出的每个用户询问成本上限下，APA比四个启发式选择基线实现了更高的净效用。在我们的成本设置中，询问每个未知偏好产生的净效用低于不询问，而APA通过27.6%的问题回收了84.2%的效用增益。获取用户偏好的价值应考虑其在未来任务中的重用，而不仅限于其对当前任务的收益。

articles.title: RIFT: KV Cache Compression for Draft Models with Complementary Compressibility Training
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding is a popular decode acceleration method. As such, it is particularly relevant to long-output generation, which requires an increasingly large KV cache. KV cache compression offers a way to constrain costs in long-context drafting. However, compression methods that focus on prefill information can lose relevance as the output length grows. We term this phenomenon decode staleness and show that it degrades draft model accuracy under selection-based KV cache compression. We introduce RIFT, a family of selection-based KV cache compression strategies that balance prefill information and recent generated tokens. We show that refreshing the KV cache selection during token generation significantly improves the drafter's quality at the cost of additional decode latency. To alleviate the refresh costs, we propose an adaptive KV refresh strategy that reduces the number of score calculations while retaining the drafter's quality. We further demonstrate how a compressibility-driven drafter training phase, based on sparse attention masks, can improve the drafter's quality under a compressed KV cache. Combined with compressibility training, RIFT enables Qwen3.5-4B, drafting for Qwen3.5-122B, to retain over 98% of its full-cache acceptance length on 32K-token inputs, 4K-token outputs, and an 8K-token KV cache budget.
articles.titleCn: RIFT：用于草稿模型的KV缓存压缩，具有互补压缩性训练
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码是一种流行的解码加速方法。因此，它特别适用于长输出生成，后者需要越来越大的KV缓存。KV缓存压缩为长上下文草稿提供了控制成本的方式。然而，专注于预填充信息的压缩方法随着输出长度的增加会失去相关性。我们将这种现象称为解码陈旧性，并证明它在基于选择的KV缓存压缩下会降低草稿模型的准确性。我们引入了RIFT，这是一系列基于选择的KV缓存压缩策略，它们在预填充信息和最近生成的标记之间取得平衡。我们表明，在生成标记期间刷新KV缓存选择可以显著提高草稿者的质量，但代价是增加了额外的解码延迟。为了缓解刷新成本，我们提出了一种自适应KV刷新策略，该策略减少了分数计算次数，同时保持了草稿者的质量。我们进一步展示了基于稀疏注意力掩码的可压缩性驱动的草稿者训练阶段，如何在压缩的KV缓存下提高草稿者的质量。结合可压缩性训练，RIFT使Qwen3.5-4B（用于Qwen3.5-122B的草稿）在32K标记输入、4K标记输出和8K标记KV缓存预算下，保持了超过98%的全缓存接受长度。

articles.title: What Pairwise Evaluation Misses: Reward Scores across Prompts
articles.abstract: Reward models score responses for preference optimization, filtering and ranking, and pooling scores across prompts needs them to be comparable. Yet pairwise evaluation compares two responses to the same prompt, so any score component shared by a prompt's responses cancels and goes untested. We study this component by comparing between-prompt variation in model scores with the same variation in human ratings of the same responses. We propose a human-referenced audit, built from a between-prompt variance share, a sibling-rating regression and prompt substitutions, and apply it to eighteen released scorers and six matched training conditions. We find that scores cluster by prompt more than the ratings do: on HelpSteer2, six reward models have between-prompt shares of 0.34 to 0.64 against a human share near zero. Replacing the original prompt with a fixed instruction keeps substantial clustering but weakens agreement with prompt-level human ratings, so clustering alone does not show agreement with humans. Part of that variation is useful: subtracting prompt means lowers the helpfulness of globally selected responses, and scores stay sensitive to a wrong prompt even when training shuffles prompt means. We propose that reward evaluation check between-prompt variation, sensitivity to a wrong prompt and usefulness for selection separately.
articles.titleCn: 配对评估所遗漏的：跨提示的奖励分数
articles.abstractCn: 奖励模型在偏好优化、过滤和排序中对响应进行评分，需要跨提示池化分数，因此它们必须具有可比性。然而，成对评估比较相同提示的两个响应，因此任何共享的提示分数成分会被抵消且未被测试。我们通过比较模型分数与人类对相同响应评分的相同变化来研究这个成分。我们提出了一种基于人类参考的审计，它由提示间方差份额、同胞评分回归和提示替换组成，并将其应用于十八个已发布的评分器和六个匹配的训练条件。我们发现，分数比评分更倾向于按提示聚类：在HelpSteer2上，六个奖励模型的提示间方差份额为0.34到0.64，而人类份额接近零。用固定的指令替换原始提示保持了显著的聚类，但削弱了与提示级人类评分的一致性，因此仅聚类并不显示与人类的一致性。其中一部分变化是有用的：减去提示均值降低了全局选择响应的帮助性，并且即使训练时打乱提示均值，分数仍然对错误提示敏感。我们建议奖励评估应分别检查提示间变化、对错误提示的敏感性和对选择的有用性。

articles.title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
articles.abstract: Policy enforcement for LLM agents has shifted from single-turn content moderation to compound, application-specific policies evaluated over multi-turn transcripts and tool-call trajectories. Fine-tuned guardrail models are efficient but degrade on compound policies, and while LLM-as-a-judge approaches achieve higher accuracy, they incur high inference cost and tend to produce unstable predictions. Neurosymbolic methods offer a natural alternative, decomposing the policy into narrow neural decisions composed under explicit logic. However, existing symbolic layers lack the required expressiveness and are optimized against fixed data rather than the policy itself. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, which compiles a policy into an executable program of neural predicates executed by small models, deterministic extractors, and code that composes their outputs. The program is optimized jointly with its training data, using adversarial generation of counterexamples that target where the program deviates from the policy. We evaluate SCOPE on a benchmark of real-world policy tasks against prompt optimization, task decomposition, and workflow generation methods, achieving the highest average accuracy across tasks and models. Programs optimized with the weakest executor transfer to other models without further optimization. This allows them to be deployed in production on inexpensive models, where they reach accuracy comparable to frontier reasoning models. Unlike these monolithic models, SCOPE produces substantially more stable predictions, and each verdict is interpretable through the predicate outputs that produced it. Additionally, we validate the key components of our method through an ablation study. SCOPE thus enables reliable, interpretable, and efficient policy enforcement at production scale.
articles.titleCn: 范围：将自然语言策略编译为神经符号谓词程序
articles.abstractCn: 针对大型语言模型代理的政策执行已从单轮内容审核转变为针对多轮文本记录和工具调用轨迹的复合型、应用特定政策评估。微调的护栏模型虽然高效，但在复合型政策上表现下降；而将LLM作为评判者的方法虽然提高了准确性，但推理成本高昂且预测结果不稳定。神经符号方法提供了一种自然替代方案，将政策分解为在显式逻辑下构成的窄神经决策。然而，现有的符号层缺乏所需的表达能力，并且是针对固定数据进行优化而非政策本身。为此，我们引入了SCOPE，它将政策编译为由小型模型、确定性提取器和组合其输出的代码执行的神经谓词可执行程序。该程序与其训练数据联合优化，通过生成针对程序偏离政策的反例进行对抗性生成。我们在真实世界政策任务基准上评估了SCOPE，与提示优化、任务分解和工作流生成方法相比，在各项任务和模型中均实现了最高平均准确率。使用最弱执行器优化的程序无需进一步优化即可迁移到其他模型。这使得它们能够部署在低成本模型上，达到与前沿推理模型相当的准确率。与这些单体模型不同，SCOPE产生的预测稳定性显著更高，并且每个裁决都可以通过产生它的谓词输出来解释。此外，我们通过消融研究验证了我们方法的关键组件。因此，SCOPE实现了在规模化生产中的可靠、可解释和高效的策略执行。

articles.title: Harm Is Behavioural, Moderation Is Lexical: How Language and Culture Decide Whom Automated Safety Systems Protect and Whom They Silence
articles.abstract: Content warning: this paper quotes slurs and hateful statements from published test suites; the racial slur among them is masked. Automated systems decide at scale which messages are harmful, and they decide unevenly. Classifiers label African American English as offensive up to twice as often as other English, the accounts of prominent drag queens can score as more toxic than those of white nationalists, and safety behaviour that holds in English collapses in low-resource languages. We argue that over-flagging and under-protection share one cause: deciding harm from vocabulary and surface form rather than from what a message does. We organise the evidence into seven failure modes and argue, as testable hypotheses, that harmful behaviours (a request for secrecy, a demand for payment, an attempt to isolate someone) travel across languages better than the words that express them. We propose an evaluation protocol that makes the gap between the best- and worst-served language communities a headline result, and show that the naive gap is inflated under equal service and that its usual bootstrap interval is unreliable. Applied to five open systems in eleven languages, from a keyword lexicon to two current multilingual guard models, the protocol finds that none reaches native-speaker accuracy at separating harmful function from harmless form (51 of 55 system-language pairs fall short); that greater capability raises discrimination in nine languages while leaving Arabic and romanised Hindi near chance, so the gap between the best- and worst-served languages grows with capability; that one system both over-flags and under-protects the same language most; and that a language a system reads worst can look the most fairly treated when only false positives are reported.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Code, simulations and per-case outputs: https://osf.io/v7aef/files/osfstorage?view_only=9449667241894b1ca7d336fc4b8259d8
articles.titleCn: 伤害是行为性的，节制是词汇性的：语言与文化如何决定自动化安全系统保护谁、压制谁
articles.abstractCn: 内容警告：本文引用了已发布测试套件中的侮辱性词汇和恶意言论；其中包含的种族侮辱性词汇已被遮盖。自动化系统在规模上决定哪些信息有害，并且决定得极不均衡。分类器将非裔美国人英语标记为攻击性的频率是其他英语的两倍，著名变装皇后账户的毒性评分可能高于白人民族主义者，而在英语中有效的安全行为在低资源语言中失效。我们认为，过度标记和不足保护有同一个原因：根据词汇和表层形式而非信息所起的作用来判断危害。我们将证据组织成七种失效模式，并作为可检验的假设提出，认为有害行为（要求保密、索要付款、试图孤立某人）比表达它们的词语跨越语言更有效。我们提出了一种评估协议，使最好和最差服务语言社区之间的差距成为头条结果，并表明在同等服务下，这种差距被夸大，而其通常的自举区间不可靠。应用于五种开放系统在十一种语言中的应用，从关键词词汇表到两种当前的多语言保护模型，该协议发现没有一个系统在区分有害功能与无害形式方面达到母语者准确度（55个系统语言对中有51个不足）；更大的能力在九种语言中提高了歧视度，而阿拉伯语和罗马化印地语接近随机，因此最好和最差服务语言之间的差距随着能力增长而扩大；一个系统对同一种语言既过度标记又不足保护；当一个系统最差阅读的语言在仅报告假阳性时，看起来最公平。

articles.title: Chunk Recomputation under Real Document Revisions: Measuring Update Cost and Retrieval Quality of Fixed, Recursive, and Content-Defined Chunking
articles.abstract: Chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation are almost always evaluated on a static snapshot, yet the documents underlying a knowledge base continue to change. Because chunks are embedded independently, a boundary that moves after an edit forces unchanged text to be re-embedded. We measure this update cost on 120 pairs of adjacent Chinese and English Wikipedia revisions for three stateless chunkers (non-overlapping fixed-size, recursive paragraph-first, and content-defined chunking) under a strict byte-identical reuse rule and a frozen dense encoder. On the 116-article common-success pool, with frozen, length-calibrated parameters, fixed-size chunking recomputes 57-68% of its full new-version embedding-input workload, recursive chunking 38-56%, and content-defined chunking 43-54% (it failed on 4 of 62 Chinese articles), while at these parameters mean evidence recall under a fixed 2048-token retrieval budget differs by less than two percentage points within either language. A cost-only parameter grid shows that the ranking of the two content-aware chunkers changes with chunk-length settings, whereas non-overlapping fixed-size chunking has the highest recomputation cost in every length-matched condition. Controlled edits and a verbatim-presence diagnostic support boundary drift as one contributor to recomputation of text already present in the previous version. Update cost is therefore a substantial, parameter-sensitive dimension that static retrieval evaluations do not expose and that should be reported alongside retrieval quality.
articles.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at AIBDCC 2026
articles.titleCn: 在真实文档修订下的块重计算：测量固定、递归和内容定义型块划分的更新成本和检索质量
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成中的分块策略几乎总是在静态快照上进行评估，然而知识库底层的文档仍在持续变化。由于分块是独立嵌入的，编辑后移动的边界会迫使未更改文本重新嵌入。我们在120对相邻的中英文维基百科修订版本上，针对三种无状态分块器（非重叠固定大小、递归段落优先和内容定义分块）在严格的字节完全重用规则和冻结密集编码器下测量了这种更新成本。在116篇文章的共同成功池中，使用冻结的、长度校准的参数，固定大小分块重新计算了57-68%的新版本嵌入输入工作量，递归分块为38-56%，内容定义分块为43-54%（在62篇中文文章中有4篇失败），而在这些参数下，固定2048个token的检索预算内，两种语言中的证据召回率差异均小于两个百分点。成本参数网格显示，两种内容感知分块器的排名会随分块长度设置而变化，而非重叠固定大小分块在所有长度匹配条件下具有最高的重新计算成本。受控编辑和逐字存在诊断支持边界漂移是导致先前版本中已存在文本重新计算的一个因素。因此，更新成本是一个重要的、参数敏感的维度，静态检索评估未能揭示这一点，并且应与检索质量一同报告。

articles.title: Mostly Reading: What Open-Book Scores Measure in Document-Level LoRA Adapters
articles.abstract: Single-document LoRA adapters have been proposed as units of knowledge to be merged and retrieved; yet open-book scoring, with the document in the prompt, can credit a document's own adapter (its specialist) for reading that document as readily as for holding it. Training one adapter for each of 150 Wikipedia articles on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we find that open-book scores mostly measure a reading behaviour every adapter shares: a random adapter trained on another document recovers 82 % of the specialist's open-book advantage over the base model but only 2 % of its advantage on a cloze probe that asks for the same document's facts without providing the source text, a share we cannot distinguish from zero. Content does reach the weights, since the specialists beat the base model in cloze recall by 0.094, and the geometry of their updates follows the documents they read; yet, in a test of 30 queries, adapters chosen by weight-space proximity or text embedding are not distinguishable from random ones on either probe, although that test cannot exclude an advantage of about four fifths of what a query's own adapter gains over a random one. At 16 documents or more, correctly scaled merges recover 87 % to 89 % of the specialists' open-book advantage but only 12 % to 16 % of their cloze advantage, with intervals that run from below zero to at most 32 %, against 94 % for joint training.We also report four silent errors, each of which produced a clean, wrong result.
articles.comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 15 tables, under review at ACL ARR
articles.titleCn: 主要阅读：文档级LoRA适配器中开卷考试成绩衡量了什么
articles.abstractCn: 单文档LoRA适配器已被提出作为待合并和检索的知识单元；然而，带有文档内容的提示词开放书评分，能同等程度地归因于文档自身的适配器（其专家）既阅读了该文档，也持有该文档。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上为150篇维基百科文章各训练一个适配器后，我们发现开放书评分主要衡量了每个适配器共有的阅读行为：一个在另一文档上训练的随机适配器能恢复专家适配器相对于基础模型的82%开放书优势，但在要求提供相同文档事实而不提供源文本的完形填空测试中，仅能恢复2%的优势，这一比例与零无异。内容确实进入了权重，因为专家适配器在完形填空召回率上比基础模型高出0.094，且其更新几何结构遵循所阅读的文档；然而，在30个查询的测试中，根据权重空间邻近度或文本嵌入选择的适配器在两种测试中均与随机适配器无异，尽管该测试不能排除查询自身适配器相对于随机适配器约四分之四的优势。在16个文档或更多的情况下，正确缩放的合并能恢复专家适配器87%至89%的开放书优势，但仅能恢复12%至16%的完形优势，其区间从负值到最多32%，而联合训练恢复率为94%。我们还报告了四个静默错误，每个错误都产生了干净但错误的结果。

articles.title: Padding to k: A Minimum Count in the Schema Makes Open-Weight Models Pad Their Extraction Lists
articles.abstract: Extraction pipelines ask language models for JSON that follows a schema, and the schema can set a minimum number of list entries. We ask what models do when the document holds fewer items than that minimum. Under a preregistered plan, we test eight open-weight models on 558 real documents from nine annotated datasets, with six more models on hosted services as a reference. Three findings stand out. First, models treat the count as a target: a minimum shown in the schema, but not enforced, raises the share of lists longer than the true count from 34.5% to 55.4%. Second, the padding is hard to catch, because most added entries are real text taken from the document; about half of them pass a check that each entry occurs in the source. Third, common fixes help only partly: a line saying fewer items are fine removes the effect on average but misses more true items, a count in prose ("up to k") also raises over-counting, an "N/A" option under an enforced minimum still leaves half the lists padded, and re-asking with the validation error makes padding far more common. We release the code, answer lists and run records at https://github.com/AbhishekBarali/padding-to-k
articles.comment: 26 pages, 4 figures. Preregistered at https://osf.io/e4r9f. Code and data: https://github.com/AbhishekBarali/padding-to-k
articles.titleCn: 填充至k：模式中的最小计数使开放权重模型填充其提取列表
articles.abstractCn: 提取管道要求语言模型提供符合架构的JSON，而架构可以设置列表条目的最小数量。我们询问当文档包含少于该最小数量的条目时，模型会怎么做。根据预先注册的计划，我们在九个标注数据集的558个真实文档上测试了八个开放权重模型，并参考了托管服务上的六个更多模型。有三个发现尤为突出。首先，模型将计数视为目标：架构中显示的最小值，但未强制执行，将列表长度超过真实计数的比例从34.5%提高到55.4%。其次，填充很难被察觉，因为大多数添加的条目都是从文档中真实提取的；其中大约一半通过了检查，即每个条目都在源中存在。第三，常见的修复方法只能部分有效：一条表示条目数量可以更少的声明平均上消除了影响，但遗漏了更多真实条目；散文中的计数（“最多k”）也会导致过度计数；“强制最小值”下的“N/A”选项仍然使一半列表被填充；使用验证错误重新提问使填充变得更加普遍。我们在https://github.com/AbhishekBarali/padding-to-k上发布了代码、答案列表和运行记录。

articles.title: ColaBench: Evaluating Memory-Guided Knowledge Acquisition in Personal Agents
articles.abstract: Personal agents need to draw on long-term interaction history to retrieve and apply external knowledge suited to a user's current request. Even an answer grounded in relevant documents can be unsuitable when it overlooks the user's circumstances. This creates two connected challenges: using historical conditions to identify the knowledge needed for a new request, and applying that knowledge to the user's situation. Existing benchmarks advance memory recall, personalized retrieval, and memory-guided action, while the joint evaluation of these two challenges remains underexplored. We introduce ColaBench, a synthetic benchmark in health and daily living, with 349 tasks across 10 Profiles and a knowledge base of 13,033 documents. Its Evidence Graph connects personal conditions to their disclosures across public interaction sessions, records prior document exposure, and links answer requirements to personal and newly acquired document evidence. We also introduce MemKB, which uses state summaries to inform queries and rule application, and memory-document links to retrieve knowledge associated with the user's history. MemKB achieves 86.25% Accuracy with an average of 4.07 interaction rounds per task. Task-level analysis finds larger gains on tasks integrating information across multiple historical Facts; error analysis further identifies unsupported personal assumptions and rule misapplication as obstacles to using retrieved evidence. ColaBench provides traceable tasks and an evaluation framework for studying how memory guides knowledge acquisition and rule application.
articles.titleCn: ColaBench：评估个人代理中的记忆引导知识获取
articles.abstractCn: 个人代理需要借助长期交互历史来检索和应用适用于用户当前请求的外部知识。即使基于相关文档的答案也可能不合适，如果它忽略了用户的实际情况。这创造了两个相互关联的挑战：利用历史条件来识别新请求所需的知识，以及将知识应用于用户的情境。现有基准提升了记忆召回、个性化检索和记忆引导行动的能力，而这两大挑战的联合评估仍待探索。我们介绍了ColaBench，这是一个合成基准，涵盖健康和日常生活领域，包含10个配置文件和349个任务，以及一个包含13033份文档的知识库。其证据图谱将个人条件与其在公开交互会话中的披露内容相连接，记录先前的文档接触情况，并将答案需求与个人及新获取的文档证据相链接。我们还引入了MemKB，它使用状态摘要来指导查询和规则应用，并通过记忆-文档链接来检索与用户历史相关的知识。MemKB在平均每个任务4.07轮交互中达到了86.25%的准确率。任务级分析发现，在整合多个历史事实信息的任务上，收益更为显著；错误分析进一步识别出不受支持的个人信息假设和规则误用是使用检索证据的障碍。ColaBench提供了可追溯的任务和评估框架，用于研究记忆如何指导知识获取和规则应用。

articles.title: Interpretive Variation and Discourse Structure in Detecting Enthymemes in Controversial Political Discourse
articles.abstract: Enthymemes are arguments that leave a premise or conclusion unstated, and they are a common persuasion device on social media. Because readers must fill in the missing part themselves, they often disagree on whether a text contains one. This paper asks how to detect and evaluate enthymemes when such disagreement is part of the task. On tweets about vaccination and immigration, each labeled by five annotators, F1 stalls around 0.67 for every fine-tuned model we train, regardless of data size, added features or label type. We therefore ask how these models should be evaluated instead, and propose metrics that compare predictions with the full distribution of annotator votes, together with a model that predicts this distribution directly and captures disagreement better at no cost in F1. We then ask what role discourse structure plays. Models learn to rely on explicit argumentative structure: they reliably recognize tweets without an enthymeme but rarely commit on tweets that contain one. Both the models and a discourse parser miss arguments whose links are left implicit and must be inferred by the reader. Finally, we discuss what these blind spots mean for content moderation systems trained on majority labels.
articles.titleCn: 解释变异与话语结构在识别争议性政治话语中的预设推理
articles.abstractCn: 省略前提或结论的论证称为省略三段论，它们是社交媒体上常见的说服手段。由于读者必须自行填补缺失部分，因此人们常常对文本是否包含省略三段论存在分歧。本文探讨在存在这种分歧的情况下，如何检测和评估省略三段论。在关于疫苗接种和移民的推文中，每条推文均由五位标注者进行标注，无论数据规模、添加的特征或标签类型如何，我们训练的每个微调模型在F1分数上都停滞在0.67左右。因此，我们探讨这些模型应该如何被评估，并提出了一种将预测与标注者投票的完整分布进行比较的指标，同时提出一个直接预测该分布的模型，该模型能更好地捕捉分歧，且不会牺牲F1分数。接着，我们探讨话语结构的作用。模型学会了依赖明确论证结构：它们能可靠地识别不包含省略三段论的推文，但很少对包含省略三段论的推文做出判断。无论是模型还是话语分析器，都会遗漏那些链接被隐含且必须由读者推断的论证。最后，我们讨论这些盲点对基于多数标签训练的内容审核系统意味着什么。

articles.title: A Reality Check of Inference-Time Context Augmentation Methods
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often fail to utilise the context given in the input, resulting in hallucinations or a fallback to parametric knowledge. Context augmentation methods aim to improve model performance by modifying the input, from inserting filler tokens that add computational time to adding relevant content such as elaboration of a context during inference. However, these methods have been evaluated in isolation and only by their performance gains, leaving it unclear how they compare and whether they reliably improve performance. In this paper, we present an evaluation framework spanning five methods that differ in how informative the inserted content is and apply them at the sentence level across seven models spanning multiple sizes on three datasets. We find that accuracy gains are not always genuine improvements but undirected perturbations: the methods correct some predictions while breaking others, particularly when the inserted text allows only for more computational time. Our analysis reveals that methods that bring no additional content primarily change model predictions near the decision boundary. Our findings highlight the need to evaluate the reliability of the accuracy gains before adopting them in practice.
articles.titleCn: 推理时上下文增强方法的现实检验
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常无法有效利用输入中提供的上下文信息，导致产生幻觉或退回到参数化知识。上下文增强方法旨在通过修改输入来提升模型性能，例如插入填充标记以增加计算时间，或在推理过程中添加相关内容（如对上下文的详细阐述）。然而，这些方法至今仅在孤立状态下被评估，且仅依据性能提升进行评价，导致其相互间的比较结果尚不明确，以及它们是否确实可靠地提升了性能仍存疑。在本文中，我们提出一个涵盖五种方法的评估框架，这些方法在插入内容的启发性上存在差异，并在七个跨不同规模的模型上，针对三个数据集，在句子级别应用这些方法。我们发现，准确率的提升并不总是真正的改进，而仅仅是未定向的扰动：这些方法纠正了一些预测，同时破坏了另一些预测，尤其是在插入文本仅允许增加计算时间的情况下。我们的分析表明，那些不引入额外内容的方法主要改变了模型在决策边界附近的预测。我们的研究结果表明，在将这些方法应用于实践之前，有必要评估其准确率提升的可靠性。

articles.title: Joint or Per-Option? Compact Encoders for Closed-Set Decisions from 17 Million to 1 Billion Parameters
articles.abstract: Many language-model pipelines end in a closed-set decision, such as selecting a tool. Prompting a large language model for it is slow and order-sensitive. We ask how small an encoder for such decisions can be and whether it should read the options jointly or separately. In a three-seed study at 32 million parameters, per-option scoring beats joint scoring on a held-out sample of a 37-benchmark decision suite by 5.8 points of chance-corrected skill at matched optimizer steps and by 2.8 at approximately matched training compute; two external benchmarks agree, though not significantly on their unseen tasks. Crossing reader with initialisation shows that the advantage requires a reranker initialisation, whose query-candidate pair input matches per-option reading; from the raw encoder the two readers are indistinguishable. Per-option scoring needs 5 to 13 times more encoder passes: at most twice the median latency, but more than four times the mean. Of six released joint encoders (17 million to 1 billion parameters), the 68- and 150-million-parameter models exceed a 435-million-parameter DeBERTa-v3 zero-shot classifier by 4.9 and 5.9 accuracy points on 209 overlap-audited System1-Arena tasks and are at least on par with it on the 145 tasks unseen in training. The smallest answers a median request in 14 milliseconds on 16 processor threads, against 728 for the classifier. Reordering options changes 12 to 23% of the joint models' answers (per-option scoring: none). Up to 68 million parameters, they lead their size range on a public leaderboard's private, mainly in-distribution tests.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/tardellirs/crivo-decision-encoders ; models: https://huggingface.co/tardellirs
articles.titleCn: 联合或按选项？从1700万到10亿参数的封闭集决策紧凑编码器
articles.abstractCn: 许多语言模型管道最终会做出封闭集决策，例如选择工具。向大型语言模型进行提示既慢又对顺序敏感。我们探究了用于此类决策的编码器可以小到什么程度，以及它应该联合还是单独读取选项。在一项涉及3200万参数的三种子研究（针对37个基准决策套件）中，按选项评分在保留样本上的表现比联合评分高出5.8个校正技能点（在匹配优化器步数时）和2.8个（在约匹配训练计算量时）；两个外部基准也支持这一结果，尽管它们在未见任务上的显著性并不一致。通过交叉读取器和初始化实验表明，这种优势需要重新排序初始化，其查询-候选对输入与按选项读取匹配；从原始编码器来看，这两个读取器是不可区分的。按选项评分需要5到13倍的编码器遍历次数：最多是中位数延迟的两倍，但超过平均值的四倍。在六个已发布的联合编码器（1700万到10亿参数）中，6800万和1.5亿参数的模型在209个重叠审计的System1-Arena任务上分别比43.5亿参数的DeBERTa-v3零样本分类器高4.9和5.9个准确率点，并且在训练中未见到的145个任务上至少与之持平。最小的模型在16个处理器线程上中位数请求只需14毫秒，而分类器需要728毫秒。重新排序选项会改变12%到23%的联合模型的答案（按选项评分：无变化）。在6800万参数以内，它们在公共排行榜的私有测试（主要为分布内测试）中领先其参数范围。

articles.title: Once a Tree, Always a Tree? Cross-lingual Transfer of Hierarchical Generalization in Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models (LMs) often exhibit successful cross-lingual transfer through continued (pre)training, still their underlying process remains unclear. One possibility is that LMs can leverage the evidence toward language-universal principles, namely, hierarchical structure, from a source language (L1) to a new language (L2), while many other non-linguistic explanations, e.g., improved initialization of position embeddings, can be potentially possible. In this study, to quantify the cross-linguistic transferability of linguistic evidence in cross-lingual LM training, we introduce a new experimental design, namely, a cross-lingual poverty-of-stimulus (CPOS) setting that ablates how LMs' hierarchical generalization in L2 can be led by structural evidence provided in L1. We contrast counterfactual L1 and L2 learning scenarios where the L2 corpus is ambiguous between linear and hierarchical grammar rules, while the amount of positive evidence for the hierarchical rule is controlled on the L1 side. Our experimental results show that LMs can partially, yet not perfectly, transfer L1 structural evidence to L2, yielding only a small but detectable hierarchical bias, while the strength of transfer depends on language pairs. We further ablate the conditions for successful transfer, motivated by recent reports on the substantial impact of vocabulary overlap. We indeed find that vocabulary overlap is crucial even for the cross-lingual transfer of hierarchical syntactic generalization. This suggests that this also explains the language-pair-dependent tendencies in the main experiments and suggests that the transfer of linguistic evidence in continued new-language learning is only conditionally achievable.
articles.titleCn: 一棵树，永远是树吗？语言模型中层级泛化的跨语言迁移
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型（LMs）通常通过持续的（预）训练展现出成功的跨语言迁移能力，但其底层机制仍不明确。一种可能性是，LMs能够利用语言普适性原则（即层级结构）的证据，从源语言（L1）迁移到新语言（L2），同时许多其他非语言解释（例如位置嵌入的改进初始化）也可能是潜在的可能。在本研究中，为了量化跨语言LM训练中语言证据的跨语言迁移能力，我们引入了一种新的实验设计，即跨语言刺激贫乏（CPOS）设置，该设置消融了如何通过L1提供的结构证据引导LMs在L2中的层级泛化。我们对比了反事实的L1和L2学习场景，其中L2语料库在线性语法规则和层级语法规则之间具有歧义，而层级规则的正面证据量在L1侧受到控制。实验结果表明，LMs可以部分而非完全地将L1结构证据迁移到L2，产生微小但可检测的层级偏差，而迁移的强度取决于语言对。我们进一步消融了成功迁移的条件，受最近关于词汇重叠重大影响的报告启发。我们发现，词汇重叠对于层级句法泛化的跨语言迁移至关重要。这表明这也解释了主要实验中的语言对依赖趋势，并表明语言证据在持续学习新语言中的迁移是条件性可实现的。

articles.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
articles.abstract: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities. Furthermore, model merging combines different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among their parameter updates. The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding and general tasks. We release IQuest-Q1 as an open-source model to support community research and development.
articles.titleCn: IQuest-Q1：提升代理式CLI系统的基础能力
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了IQuest-Q1，一个稀疏专家混合（MoE）智能体基础模型，总参数量为320B（激活参数量为15B）。IQuest-Q1通过三阶段过程开发而成：（1）稳定高效的预训练，结合Stable SplitNorm、Muon和muP，采用两阶段课程，第二阶段增加编码数据的混合比例，在安全学习率和最优学习率之间保持较宽的稳定性裕度；（2）细粒度中训练，跨领域和格式扩展数据混合比例，并逐步扩展上下文长度；（3）多框架多版本后训练，通过不同框架结合SFT、领域专用强化学习和MOPD，整合互补的训练信号，增强智能体编码能力。此外，模型合并技术将不同阶段的专家和检查点进行整合，同时缓解参数更新之间的冲突。最终形成的IQuest-Q1在编码和通用任务方面均展现出能力。我们以开源模型形式发布IQuest-Q1，以支持社区的研究与发展。

articles.title: RetiJev: Fast and Source-Grounded Ophthalmic Decision Models
articles.abstract: Ophthalmic clinical decision support requires fast, accurate, and privacy-preserving inference, yet autoregressive large language models (LLMs) incur substantial latency and computational overhead for decisions among predefined actions. We therefore investigate a decision-oriented alternative to generative reasoning. Specifically, we first introduce RetiJev-Data, a source-grounded ophthalmology corpus comprising 78,158 clinical-decision and diagnosis questions derived from articles in PubMed Central and a MeSH vocabulary covering 531 eye diseases, and 50,074 guideline-grading questions spanning 11 grading systems, along with a 24,662-question evaluation benchmark. Based on this, we develop RetiJev, a family of 0.8B-9B decision models that directly score candidate answers without autoregressive decoding. Across all model sizes, RetiJev outperforms both a 27B LLM and the commercial Jev 1.13 decision model on guideline grading by 10.4-23.0 points. RetiJev-9B further achieves the highest accuracy on clinical decisions, improving over both baselines by 5.4-6.5 points while matching them on diagnosis. It answers a case in 158 ms on one GPU, 3.5x faster than LLM generation and 470x faster than reasoning. Models are released at https://github.com/Awenbocc/RetiJev.
articles.titleCn: RetiJev：快速且基于源代码的眼科决策模型
articles.abstractCn: 眼科临床决策支持需要快速、准确且保护隐私的推理，但自回归大型语言模型（LLM）在预定义动作间的决策中会产生显著的延迟和计算开销。因此，我们研究了一种面向决策的生成推理替代方案。具体而言，我们首先引入了RetiJev-Data，这是一个基于来源的眼科语料库，包含78,158个临床决策和诊断问题，这些问题源自PubMed Central的文章和一个涵盖531种眼病的MeSH词汇，以及跨越11个分级系统的50,074个指南分级问题，此外还有一个包含24,662个问题的评估基准。基于此，我们开发了RetiJev，这是一系列0.8B-9B的决策模型，它们可以直接对候选答案进行评分，而无需自回归解码。在所有模型尺寸中，RetiJev在指南分级任务上均优于27B LLM和商业Jev 1.13决策模型，性能提升达10.4-23.0分。RetiJev-9B在临床决策任务上达到了最高准确率，相较于基线模型提升了5.4-6.5分，同时在诊断任务上与基线模型持平。它在单个GPU上回答一个案例仅需158毫秒，比LLM生成速度快3.5倍，比推理速度快470倍。模型已发布在https://github.com/Awenbocc/RetiJev。

articles.title: Tracing Hallucinations in LLM Reasoning for UML Class Diagram Generation: An Empirical Taxonomy and Mitigation Study
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate UML class diagrams from natural language requirements, but hallucinations may compromise the correctness and completeness of the resulting diagrams. Existing evaluations mostly assess the final diagram, without examining the intermediate traces of reasoning-capable LLMs, which can reveal where these hallucinations arise. We develop an empirical taxonomy of eleven hallucination sub-types organised into three dimensions: Prompt Faithfulness (deviations between requirements and reasoning), Code Faithfulness (discrepancies between reasoning and generated PlantUML code), and Reasoning Quality (problems within the reasoning). The taxonomy was derived from 60 manually annotated DeepSeek-R1 traces, applied to 120 further DeepSeek-R1 traces through a dual-LLM annotation pipeline, and examined on 20 DeepSeek-V4-Pro traces. Code Faithfulness was the most frequent dimension for DeepSeek-R1 in both datasets, whereas Prompt Faithfulness dominated for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, suggesting model-dependent failure patterns. In the manually annotated traces, reasoning-trace length showed no significant monotonic association with hallucination frequency, whereas requirement complexity was negatively associated with it, particularly for Prompt Faithfulness errors. In a mitigation experiment on 13 Golden UML ModelSet cases with three Qwen3-based models, adding Prompt Faithfulness and Reasoning Quality constraints to the generation prompt raised the pooled mean F1 score by 4.0 percentage points, whereas a post-hoc Code Faithfulness review provided no consistent further benefit. Relationship modelling remained the lowest-scoring element throughout. These results suggest that localising hallucinations within the generation process can inform targeted, prompt-based mitigation. Whether these findings generalise beyond the DeepSeek and Qwen3 model families remains to be tested.
articles.titleCn: 基于LLM推理的UML类图生成中的幻觉追踪：一项实证分类和缓解研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够根据自然语言需求生成UML类图，但幻觉现象可能损害生成图的正确性和完整性。现有评估主要针对最终图进行，未考察推理型LLMs的中间推理过程，而这些过程可以揭示幻觉产生的根源。我们开发了一种包含11种幻觉子类型的经验性分类体系，分为三个维度：提示忠实度（需求与推理之间的偏差）、代码忠实度（推理与生成PlantUML代码之间的差异）以及推理质量（推理过程中的问题）。该分类体系基于60条人工标注的DeepSeek-R1推理轨迹构建，通过双LLM标注流程应用于120条进一步DeepSeek-R1轨迹，并在20条DeepSeek-V4-Pro轨迹上进行验证。在两个数据集中，DeepSeek-R1的代码忠实度维度频率最高，而DeepSeek-V4-Pro则以提示忠实度维度为主，表明模型相关的失效模式。在人工标注的轨迹中，推理轨迹长度与幻觉频率无显著单调关联，而需求复杂度则呈负相关，尤其是在提示忠实度错误方面。在13个Golden UML ModelSet案例中，针对三种基于Qwen3的模型进行的缓解实验显示，向生成提示中添加提示忠实度和推理质量约束将平均F1分数提升了4个百分点，而事后代码忠实度审查未提供持续稳定的额外收益。关系建模始终是得分最低的环节。这些结果表明，在生成过程中定位幻觉有助于指导基于提示的针对性缓解。这些发现是否适用于DeepSeek和Qwen3模型家族之外，仍有待验证。

articles.title: Verbalizing Activation Differences with Natural Language Autoencoders
articles.abstract: Activation verbalizers translate the internal representations of large language models into human-readable text. The recently proposed natural language autoencoders (NLAs) learn this by reconstructing activations through a natural language bottleneck. However, it remains unclear how well these methods generalize beyond the setting they were trained for. Here, we study this question for NLAs along four closely related questions: (i) Do NLA verbalizations exhibit compositional structure with respect to their input? (ii) Do NLAs generalize to finetuned versions of the model they were trained for? (iii) Can NLAs recover finetuning objectives in model diffing? (iv) Can NLAs be specialized for model diffing? Across four models from three families, our experiments provide evidence supporting a largely positive answer to all four questions. Specifically, verbalizations of composed analogy activations mostly name the target while rarely mentioning the subtracted word, and an NLA can be reused on lightweight finetunes of its original model without retraining, with reconstruction quality degrading noticeably only for the largest model. Verbalizing activation differences between Taboo model organisms and their original models recovers the concealed secret word for most organisms, and reinforcement learning on activation differences further improves this recovery on held-out organisms. We also find that NLAs can recover the finetuning objective without the finetuned model generating any token, since the most informative token positions precede the user prompt. NLAs do not yet match state-of-the-art model diffing methods on the emergent misalignment detection task, but outperform a blackbox baseline. Our findings suggest that NLAs can meaningfully verbalize differences in activation space, rendering NLAs a promising direction for future work.
articles.titleCn: 用自然语言自动编码器描述激活差异
articles.abstractCn: 激活语言化器将大型语言模型的内部表示转换为人类可读的文本。最近提出的自然语言自动编码器（NLAs）通过自然语言瓶颈重建激活来学习这一点。然而，这些方法在超出其训练设置的情况下泛化能力如何仍不清楚。在此，我们针对NLAs研究这一问题，通过四个密切相关的问题：(i) NLA语言化是否在其输入上表现出组合结构？(ii) NLA是否泛化到其训练模型的微调版本？(iii) NLA能否在模型差异分析中恢复微调目标？(iv) NLA能否专门用于模型差异分析？通过对三个家族的四个模型进行实验，我们的实验结果为所有四个问题提供了支持性证据。具体而言，组合类比激活的语言化主要命名目标词而很少提及被减去的词，并且NLA可以在其原始模型的轻量级微调上重复使用而无需重新训练，只有最大模型的重构质量明显下降。语言化禁忌模型生物与其原始模型之间的激活差异，对大多数生物恢复了隐藏的秘密词，并且对保留的生物在激活差异上的强化学习进一步提高了这种恢复。我们还发现，NLAs可以在微调模型不生成任何token的情况下恢复微调目标，因为最信息丰富的token位置先于用户提示。在涌现性错位检测任务上，NLAs尚未达到最先进的模型差异分析方法，但优于黑盒基线。我们的研究表明，NLAs能够在激活空间中有意义地语言化差异，使NLAs成为未来工作的一个有前景的方向。

articles.title: ReflectPO: Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
articles.abstract: With external tools, large language models (LLMs) can tackle complex tasks through sustained environmental interaction. LLM-based agents are therefore increasingly used to tackle complex long-horizon tasks in real-world environments. However, these tasks involve sequential, interdependent decisions and changes in environmental states. Early execution errors affect subsequent interaction histories and environmental states, and their effects accumulate along the decision chain. To address this challenge, we propose Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization (ReflectPO), a reinforcement learning framework for autonomous error recovery in long-horizon tasks. ReflectPO comprises two core components. The first is Reflection-Guided Sampling. We use branch differences and repeated visits in interaction trajectories to construct hints for error recovery. The second is Tree-Structured Credit Assignment. We organize sampled trajectories into trees and assign action-level credit using parent--child reward differences and recovery gains. Experiments over two long-horizon tool-use benchmarks show that ReflectPO outperforms multiple existing baselines in most domains. It also achieves the best overall performance on average. Further analyses show that ReflectPO effectively improves agents' ability to recognize their own deviations, recover from erroneous states, and continue making progress toward task completion.
articles.titleCn: 反射策略优化：用于长时程大型语言模型智能体的反射引导策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 借助外部工具，大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过持续的环境交互来处理复杂任务。因此，基于LLM的智能体越来越多地被用于在现实环境中处理复杂的长期任务。然而，这些任务涉及序列化、相互依赖的决策以及环境状态的变化。早期的执行错误会影响后续的交互历史和环境状态，并且这些影响会沿着决策链累积。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了反思引导策略优化（ReflectPO），这是一个用于长期任务自主错误恢复的强化学习框架。ReflectPO包含两个核心组件。第一个是反思引导采样。我们利用交互轨迹中的分支差异和重复访问来构建错误恢复的提示。第二个是树状结构归因。我们将采样轨迹组织成树状结构，并使用父节点与子节点的奖励差异和恢复收益来分配动作级别的信用。在两个长期工具使用基准测试中的实验表明，ReflectPO在大多数领域优于多个现有基线，并且在平均性能上实现了最佳。进一步的分析表明，ReflectPO有效提高了智能体识别自身偏差、从错误状态中恢复以及继续向任务完成目标推进的能力。

articles.title: Hierarchical Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Alignment via Dynamic Granularity Discovery and Optimal Transport
articles.abstract: Fine-grained image-text retrieval requires a model not only to assess global semantic consistency between an image and a text, but also to model visual evidence for local textual semantics, including objects, attributes, quantities, actions, and relations, so as to distinguish semantically similar candidates. Existing methods commonly use fixed image patches, detected regions, or text tokens as the basic matching units and then aggregate local interactions through max pooling, cross attention, or similarity accumulation. Such strategies remain limited in semantic unit construction and global matching consistency. This paper proposes a hierarchical fine-grained cross-modal alignment framework, termed HFCMA. The framework progressively transforms low-level patch and token representations into adaptive visual regions and textual phrases, and then performs structured region-phrase matching within a global retrieval scoring process. Specifically, HFCMA first adopts dynamic granularity discovery (DGD) to aggregate raw patches and tokens into semantically compact visual regions and textual phrases. It then formulates region-phrase matching as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby estimating a structured alignment matrix under global marginal constraints. To reduce background noise and local semantic drift, HFCMA further introduces background debiasing, textual importance weighting, and prototype consistency regularization. Experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO show that HFCMA effectively combines dynamic semantic unit construction with OT-based structured matching under a dual-encoder retrieval framework. The resulting fine-grained score provides structured local alignment information for candidate ranking and improves the discrimination of subtle semantic differences.
articles.comment: 8 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/sungkites/HFCMA
articles.titleCn: 基于动态粒度发现的最优传输的层次细粒度跨模态对齐
articles.abstractCn: 细粒度图像文本检索需要模型不仅评估图像与文本之间的全局语义一致性，还要对局部文本语义进行建模，包括物体、属性、数量、动作和关系，以区分语义相似的候选。现有方法通常使用固定的图像块、检测到的区域或文本标记作为基本匹配单元，并通过最大池化、交叉注意力或相似度累积来聚合局部交互。这些策略在语义单元构建和全局匹配一致性方面仍然存在局限。本文提出了一种层次化的细粒度跨模态对齐框架，称为HFCMA。该框架逐步将低级块和标记表示转换为自适应的视觉区域和文本短语，然后在全局检索评分过程中执行结构化的区域-短语匹配。具体而言，HFCMA首先采用动态粒度发现（DGD）将原始块和标记聚合成语义紧凑的视觉区域和文本短语。然后，将区域-短语匹配表述为一个熵正则化的最优传输问题，从而在全局边缘约束下估计一个结构化对齐矩阵。为了减少背景噪声和局部语义漂移，HFCMA进一步引入背景去偏、文本重要性加权以及原型一致性正则化。在Flickr30K和MS-COCO上的实验表明，HFCMA有效地结合了动态语义单元构建与基于最优传输的结构化匹配，在双编码器检索框架下取得了显著效果。所得的细粒度评分提供了结构化的局部对齐信息，用于候选排序，并提高了对细微语义差异的区分能力。

articles.title: Silicon Samples Match the Answers but Not the Respondents
articles.abstract: Silicon sampling generates survey respondents by having a large language model (LLM) answer a survey as a person with given demographic attributes, and the resulting synthetic populations are increasingly used in place of human ones. Existing evaluations focus on individual-answer accuracy, per-question answer distributions, and correlations across questions. None of these compares the respondents themselves, so a generator whose respondents have combinations of answers found in no human respondent can still score well if it reproduces every answer distribution. We propose the respondent coverage gap (RCG), which represents each respondent as a point defined by their complete answer profile and measures how far each human respondent is from the nearest generated one, relative to the distance between human samples. On two US social surveys, all six LLMs we evaluate leave human respondents uncovered, and under our main settings, they fall behind a baseline that samples each answer independently from the human marginals. Across the prompting and inference settings we test, every LLM has a higher RCG than a Gaussian copula fitted to the human data.
articles.titleCn: 硅样品与答案相符，但与受访者不符。
articles.abstractCn: 硅基抽样通过让大型语言模型（LLM）以具有给定人口统计属性的个人身份回答调查问卷来生成调查受访者，由此产生的合成人口正越来越多地替代真人人口。现有的评估主要关注单个答案的准确性、每道题目的答案分布以及题目间的相关性。这些评估方法均未对受访者本身进行比较，因此即使某个生成器的受访者答案组合在人类受访者中不存在，只要它能重现所有答案分布，仍然可以获得高分。我们提出了受访者覆盖差距（RCG）这一指标，将每个受访者表示为一个由其完整答案特征定义的点，并衡量每个真人受访者与最近生成的受访者之间的距离，相对于真人样本之间的距离。在两个美国社会调查中，我们评估的六种LLM均未能覆盖真人受访者，在我们的主要设置下，它们的表现甚至落后于从真人边缘分布中独立采样答案的基线模型。在我们测试的提示和推理设置中，每种LLM的RCG都高于拟合在真人数据上的高斯 Copula 模型。

articles.title: From Perpetrators' Digital Footprints to Behavioral Communities: An Ontology-Driven Framework for Bengali Cyberbullying Analysis--- FULL VERSION
articles.abstract: Cyberbullying involves behavioral and contextual patterns beyond isolated abusive messages. However, existing approaches remain fragmented across content detection, semantic representation, and network analysis, with limited interpretable perpetrator representations, multi-scale structural modeling, and explanations of behavior-driven similarity and influence propagation. These limitations hinder the identification of persistent perpetrators, characterization of behavioral communities, and assessment of potentially influential users. This paper proposes Ontology-Driven Cyberbullying Behavior and Network Analysis (ODCBNA), a perpetrator-centric framework integrating requirements-driven ontology design, knowledge graph construction, behavioral modeling, community analysis, and influence modeling. Using the Bengali Contextual and Diverse Cyberbullying (BenCoDiC) corpus as a use case, ODCBNA identifies $1{,}063$ users with at least three bullying comments or replies as perpetrators and represents each through a $64$-dimensional behavioral and contextual feature vector. Cosine similarity and $k$-nearest-neighbor modeling produce a weighted network with $27{,}554$ edges. Louvain analysis identifies six communities with a modularity of approximately $0.495$ and $27$ sub-communities. Feature-contribution analysis identifies the Video, Impact, and User Profile groups as the strongest contributors to behavioral similarity and community separation, while contextual dimensions support interpretation. Community-constrained influence analysis shows that IM Greedy achieves small positive gains in all six communities, although different seed-selection methods produce comparable diffusion spreads despite limited seed overlap. These findings provide an interpretable basis for understanding perpetrator behavior, community organization, and potential influence patterns in Bengali online environments.
articles.titleCn: 从施暴者的数字足迹到行为社群：用于孟加拉语网络欺凌分析的本体驱动框架——完整版
articles.abstractCn: 网络欺凌涉及超越孤立侮辱性信息的行為和情境模式。然而，现有方法在内容检测、语义表示和网络分析方面仍保持碎片化，缺乏对施害者行为的可解释表示、多尺度结构建模，以及对行为驱动相似性和影响传播的解释。这些局限性阻碍了对持续施害者的识别、行为社区的表征以及潜在影响用户的评估。本文提出了本体驱动网络欺凌行为与网络分析（ODCBNA），这是一个以施害者为中心的框架，整合了需求驱动本体设计、知识图谱构建、行为建模、社区分析和影响建模。以孟加拉语情境化和多样化网络欺凌语料库（BenCoDiC）为例，ODCBNA识别出至少有三次欺凌评论或回复的1063名用户为施害者，并通过64维行为和情境特征向量来表示每个用户。余弦相似度和k近邻建模产生了一个包含27,554条边的加权网络。Louvain分析识别出六个社区，模块度约为0.495，以及27个子社区。特征贡献分析将视频、影响和用户资料组识别为行为相似性和社区分离的最强贡献者，而情境维度支持解释。社区约束影响分析表明，IM Greedy在所有六个社区中都实现了微小的正向增益，尽管不同的种子选择方法产生了可比的传播扩散，尽管种子重叠有限。这些发现为理解孟加拉语在线环境中的施害者行为、社区组织和潜在影响模式提供了可解释的基础。

articles.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. Finally, we show that marker frequency alone does not indicate RL-induced reasoning and caution against LLM-as-a-judge revision metrics, as automated judges can reverse human-labelled trends.
articles.titleCn: 继承而非创造：追溯推理模型中“等待”的来源
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）被认为教会了推理模型在重新考虑步骤前写下{wait}，但大幅提升的RL准确率并不需要这个单词。这种观点可能会混淆RL发现的内容与模型从训练数据中继承的内容。我们通过追踪开放模型训练历史中的这个单词，利用无标签的频率、位置、形式和使用情况指标以及注入错误测试（所有计算均基于采样输出），发现零RL几乎从不创造这个标记：在缺乏该单词的基础上，RL显著提高了MATH-500的准确率，而{wait}仍然保持接近缺失状态。它随着训练数据出现：在OLMo-3的中间训练阶段出现，而在推理轨迹上的微调则将之安装到大多数基础模型中（这些基础模型原本缺乏该单词）。当基础模型已经使用该单词时，释放的RL-Zero配方（OLMo-3、MiMo）会放大它，而来自相同基础的KL无约束GRPO则不会；OLMo-3的配方削弱了它的形式，使其成为一个更敏感但更宽松的警报；在监督微调后的RL几乎未改变它，而我们的GRPO配方则抹除了由微调种下的标记。最后，我们证明仅凭标记频率并不能表明RL引发的推理，并警告不要使用LLM作为裁判的修订指标，因为自动裁判可以逆转人类标注的趋势。

articles.title: One Teacher, Many Views: Reducing Reference Sensitivity in On-Policy Self-Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. To address this instability, we introduce Monte Carlo Privileged Distillation (MCPD), which models privileged context as a distribution over partial reference views and distills the marginal teacher distribution. MCPD evaluates the teacher under multiple views and averages the resulting next-token distributions. We show that this probability-space average is the exact target induced by minimizing the expected teacher-to-student KL divergence over privileged views. Across mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks, we show that MCPD produces more reference-consistent supervision and consistently improves over full-reference OPSD.
articles.titleCn: 一位教师，多种视角：降低在线策略自我蒸馏中的参考敏感性
articles.abstractCn: 策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）通过使用参考解条件化特权副本提供的密集标记级监督，在其自身轨迹上训练模型来改进推理。现有方法通常使用基于完整参考的单个教师分布。我们识别出这种公式的局限性：参考只是推理过程的一个实现。尽管它提供了关于答案的证据，但也编码了顺序、措辞和解决方案路径。因此，完整参考条件化可能产生过度依赖推理时学生无法获取信息的正确目标。我们证明，在保持问题和学生状态不变的情况下，用另一个有效参考替换当前参考会显著改变教师分布，这种现象我们称为参考诱导的目标不稳定性。为解决这种不稳定性，我们引入了蒙特卡洛特权蒸馏（MCPD），该技术将特权上下文建模为部分参考视图的分布，并蒸馏边际教师分布。MCPD在多个视图下评估教师，并平均产生的下一个标记分布。我们证明，这种概率空间平均正是通过在特权视图上最小化预期教师到学生的KL散度所诱导的确切目标。在数学和科学推理基准测试中，我们展示了MCPD产生了更一致的参考监督，并且始终如一地优于完整参考OPSD。

articles.title: Synthetic-to-Real Code-Switched ASR: A Spontaneous Nepali-English Podcast Benchmark
articles.abstract: Nepali-English code-switched conversational speech presents severe challenges for automatic speech recognition (ASR), chiefly through script confusion (inappropriate mixing of Devanagari and Latin orthography) and elevated error rates at language switch points. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can adapt multilingual foundation models, but human code-switched audio is expensive to collect and annotate. We curate a new benchmark of 13,044 spontaneous podcast utterances (15.45 h total; 10,214 test, 2,830 dev), audited and verified to eliminate machine translation leakages and acoustic loops. We investigate a two-stage synthetic-to-real adaptation framework: Stage 1 applies SFT on 0.95 h of speech synthesized via a multi-speaker, dual-engine TTS pipeline; Stage 2 explores Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with transcription and script rewards. We find that synthetic SFT provides the primary cross-domain transfer to spontaneous human speech, reducing Mixed Error Rate (MER) from 23.40% to 21.52% (-1.88 pp) and switch-point error rate (SPER) from 35.89% to 28.77% (-7.12 pp). Subsequent GRPO yields small, statistically significant adjustments on 173 test utterances (1.69%), driving English script confusion (SCR_en) from 6.45% to 6.36% (p <= 0.001) and SPER to 28.70% (p = 0.022 clustered). Crucially, ablation reveals that in this SFT-converged encoder-decoder setting, an auxiliary script reward term yields performance identical to MER-only optimization because rollout candidate groups exhibit near-zero script variance on synthetic data. On monolingual benchmarks, SFT improves Nepali MER by 2.71 pp (stabilizing at 18.42% after GRPO, a 2.38 pp gain over baseline) while preserving English lexical WER (3.38% vs. 3.33%). Verified transcripts, timestamps, episode metadata, and reconstruction scripts are publicly released.
articles.titleCn: 合成到真实代码转换语音识别：一个自发的尼泊尔-英语播客基准
articles.abstractCn: 尼泊尔-英语代码转换的会话语音对自动语音识别（ASR）提出了严峻挑战，主要表现为书写系统混淆（印地文和拉丁文书写的不当混合）以及语言转换点处错误率升高。监督微调（SFT）能够适应多语言基础模型，但人类代码转换音频的收集和标注成本高昂。我们整理了一个包含13,044个自发播客话语的新基准（总时长15.45小时；10,214个测试样本，2,830个开发样本），经过审核验证以消除机器翻译泄露和声学循环。我们研究了一种从合成到真实的两阶段适应框架：第一阶段在通过多说话人、双引擎TTS流程合成的0.95小时语音上应用SFT；第二阶段探索带有转录和书写奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）。我们发现合成SFT为自发人声提供了主要的跨域迁移，将混合错误率（MER）从23.40%降至21.52%（-1.88个基点），将转换点错误率（SPER）从35.89%降至28.77%（-7.12个基点）。后续的GRPO在173个测试话语（占1.69%）上产生了微小但统计上显著的调整，将英语书写混淆（SCR_en）从6.45%降至6.36%（p≤0.001），将SPER降至28.70%（p=0.022，聚类分析）。关键在于消融实验表明，在这个SFT收敛的编码器-解码器设置中，一个辅助书写奖励项的性能与仅优化MER相同，因为合成数据上的候选组表现出近乎零的书写方差。在单语基准上，SFT将尼泊尔MER提升了2.71个基点（在GRPO后稳定在18.42%，比基线提升2.38个基点），同时保留了英语词汇错误率（WER）（3.38% vs. 3.33%）。验证后的转录文本、时间戳、节目元数据和重建脚本已公开发布。

articles.title: TRIAD: Benchmarking Omni-Modal Ambiguity in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Ambiguity is a central feature of natural communication: a sentence, image, or sound may remain underspecified until evidence from the other channels is considered. Yet current multimodal benchmarks mostly test perception, recognition, or reasoning over already determinate inputs, leaving unclear whether omni-modal large language models can resolve ambiguity distributed across text, vision, and audio. We introduce TRIAD, a benchmark for omni-modal ambiguity resolution. Each item is a text--image--audio triplet paired with a question and a set of answer options, and is constructed so that the full triplet determines a unique answer while removing any one modality makes the set of consistent options non-unique. TRIAD contains $327$ hand-written queries in $86$ scene groups and covers $18$ ambiguity categories across the three modalities. Evaluating $14$ omni-modal systems reveals that strong item-level performance does not translate into robust scene-level disambiguation: the best model still trails humans by over $20$ points in group accuracy. Removing answer options widens the gap further, driving model group accuracy to the single digits while humans remain robust. Leave-one-out and transcript/description counterfactuals further show that current systems often underuse audio cues when text and image are present. TRIAD reframes omni-modal evaluation around disambiguation rather than recognition, and provides a taxonomy, benchmark, and diagnostic protocol for measuring this capability.
articles.titleCn: TRIAD：多模态大型语言模型中全模态歧义的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 歧义性是自然交流的核心特征：一个句子、图像或声音可能在没有其他渠道的证据之前保持未明确。然而，当前的多模态基准主要测试对已确定输入的感知、识别或推理，这留下了疑问：全模态大型语言模型能否解决跨越文本、视觉和音频的分布式歧义。我们介绍了TRIAD，一个用于全模态歧义解决的全模态基准。每个项目是一个文本-图像-音频三元组，配有一个问题和一组答案选项，其构建方式是三元组完全确定一个唯一答案，而移除任何一个模态都会使一致选项集变得非唯一。TRIAD包含$327$个手写查询，分布在$86$个场景组中，覆盖了跨越三个模态的$18$个歧义类别。评估$14$个全模态系统表明，强大的项目级性能并不能转化为稳健的场景级消歧：最佳模型的组准确率仍比人类低超过$20$分。移除答案选项进一步扩大了差距，将模型的组准确率降至个位数，而人类的表现依然稳健。留一法和转录/描述反事实进一步表明，当前系统在文本和图像存在时往往低估音频线索的使用。TRIAD将全模态评估重新聚焦于消歧而非识别，并提供了一个分类体系、基准测试和诊断协议来衡量这种能力。

articles.title: TutorCaseBench: A Case-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Tutors in Supporting Students with Challenging Behaviors
articles.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as AI tutors, yet existing benchmarks overlook the challenging behaviors common among students with learning and behavioral difficulties. We introduce TutorCaseBench, a benchmark that grounds AI-tutor evaluation in qualitative case studies from pedagogy, educational psychology, and special education. Our pipeline converts documented student categories into case-specific scenarios, tutor-student dialogues, and rubrics grounded in source evidence. The benchmark contains 923 dialogues across five challenge types, evaluated through open-ended response generation (1,560 items) and multiple-choice selection (2,537 items). Across 11 state-of-the-art LLMs, even the strongest model satisfies a rubric criterion in only 55.8% of open-ended cases, while models are better at selecting appropriate strategies than generating situated responses. These results reveal a gap between intervention recognition and context-specific adaptation, especially for open-weight models. All data are publicly available at https://github.com/kixlab/TutorCaseBench.
articles.titleCn: TutorCaseBench：一个用于评估支持有挑战性行为学生的语言模型助教的案例基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用作AI助教，然而现有的基准测试忽略了学习障碍和行为问题学生常见的挑战行为。我们介绍了TutorCaseBench，这是一个基于教育学、教育心理学和特殊教育领域定性案例研究来评估AI助教的基准测试。我们的流程将记录的学生类别转换为特定案例场景、助教-学生对话以及基于源证据的评分标准。该基准测试包含针对五种挑战类型的923段对话，通过开放式回答生成（1,560项）和多项选择（2,537项）进行评估。在11个最先进的LLM中，即使是性能最强的模型也仅在55.8%的开放式案例中满足评分标准，而模型在选择适当策略方面优于生成情境化回答。这些结果表明干预识别与情境化适应之间存在差距，尤其对于开放式权重模型。所有数据均可在https://github.com/kixlab/TutorCaseBench公开获取。

articles.title: Invisibilization as a Source of Probability Bias in Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models are aligned to avoid using protected attributes such as race, ethnicity, and gender to inform their responses. Therefore, they increasingly refuse or hedge when such attributes appear in a prompt. However, if a system must decide how much to learn from what people tell it, it is costly to refuse valuable information because of its source. In this article, we measure the cost of declining information in a two-urn game with an exact Bayesian answer. We present leading LLM models from two developers (OpenAI and Anthropic) with a prompt that requires them to decide how far to trust an unverifiable report from a participant whose description we randomize across ten configurations (6,600 sessions). We show that leading models often decline to assess the reporter, treating information as worthless at rates set by the description rather than by the evidence. At its widest, models decline a Black-described reporter 46% of the time and a white-described reporter 9%; yet, when they do assess the information, the Black-described reporter receives slightly more trust. The bias is invisible to audits that compare average trust or look only at assessed cases. It grows with reasoning effort, follows words rather than categories (models invoke race for "Black" but not for its Spanish translation negro, and never for "Indigenous"), and worsens under warning instructions a practitioner would try first. We also present a scoring option that reduces the refusal rate bias. When a model's trust is scored against revealed truth over repeated rounds, it credits identical records equally. In four of five configurations from Anthropic and OpenAI, the racial gap in trust falls below 0.02 by the last rounds.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型中概率偏差的来源：隐形化
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型被设计为避免使用种族、民族和性别等受保护属性来影响其回应。因此，当这些属性出现在提示中时，它们会越来越拒绝或回避。然而，如果一个系统必须决定从人们提供的信息中学习多少，因为信息来源而拒绝有价值的信息是昂贵的。在本文中，我们通过一个具有精确贝叶斯答案的两 urn 游戏来衡量拒绝信息的成本。我们向来自两家公司（OpenAI 和 Anthropic）的领先大型语言模型展示一个提示，要求它们决定如何信任一个来自参与者的不可验证报告，其中参与者的描述在十个配置（6,600 个会话）中随机化。我们发现，领先模型经常拒绝评估报告人，将信息视为无价值的比率由描述设定，而非由证据设定。在最宽的情况下，模型拒绝评估描述为黑人报告人的次数为 46%，描述为白人的为 9%；然而，当他们确实评估信息时，描述为黑人的报告人会获得略高的信任。这种偏见对比较平均信任或仅查看评估案例的审计来说是看不见的。它随着推理努力的增加而增长，遵循词语而非类别（模型会为“Black”调用种族，但不会为西班牙语翻译“negro”调用，也永远不会为“Indigenous”调用），并且在实践中首先尝试的警告指令下会恶化。我们还提出了一种评分选项，可以减少拒绝率的偏见。当模型在多轮中根据揭示的真相对其信任进行评分时，它会平等地对待相同的记录。在 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的五个配置中的四个中，到最后一轮时，信任中的种族差距下降到 0.02 以下。

articles.title: MixJudge: Learning a Language-Queryable Critic for Vocal Mixing
articles.abstract: Mixing requires not only applying processing but also assessing the resulting mix. Audio-language models can provide conversa- tional mixing advice, but existing evaluations do not separately test whether they can judge specific mixing issues. Since professional supervision for such judgments is scarce, we construct a curriculum of 11 vocal-mix issues at multiple severity levels and use it to train MixJudge, a language-queryable audio critic. MixJudge shows its ability to retrieve mixing issues, distinguish opposite issues, and order the severity of an issue. Moreover, its judgments transfer to menu selection: given a set of processing candidates, MixJudge often favors versions acoustically closer to a held-out professional version, demonstrating how explicit mixing judgment can support comparison and downstream mixing decisions.
articles.titleCn: MixJudge：学习一种语言可查询的评论家用于人声混音
articles.abstractCn: 混音不仅需要应用处理，还需要评估混音结果。音频语言模型可以提供对话式混音建议，但现有评估并未单独测试它们能否判断特定混音问题。由于专业判断此类问题较为稀缺，我们构建了一个包含11个不同严重程度的声乐混音问题的课程，并利用它来训练MixJudge，一个可通过语言查询的音频评论器。MixJudge展示了其检索混音问题、区分相反问题以及排序问题严重程度的能力。此外，其判断结果可迁移至菜单选择：给定一组处理候选方案，MixJudge通常倾向于与一个保留的专业版本在声学上更接近的版本，这表明明确的混音判断如何支持比较和下游混音决策。

articles.title: Where meanings converge and diverge: Revisiting linguistic relativity across 81 languages
articles.abstract: Do people who speak different languages organize concepts in similar ways? This question lies at the heart of the Sapir--Whorf hypothesis and debates about linguistic relativity. Shared basic meanings, however, need not imply shared relations among them. We compared relations among 196 basic concepts across 81 languages, using word embeddings from two multilingual models to quantify conceptual structure expressed in language. Cross-language correspondence was greater for sociocultural meanings than for meanings concerning nature and motion, a contrast recurring across models and classifications. Within the sociocultural domain, relational differences increased with geographic separation; less closely related languages differed more across all domains. These findings suggest that universality and relativity are interwoven across conceptual domains. They inform an account in which shared cognitive resources interact with linguistic and local experience, and predict greater cross-language correspondence in human semantic judgments for sociocultural than for nature and motion meanings.
articles.titleCn: 意义汇聚与分歧之处：跨81种语言重探语言相对论
articles.abstractCn: 说不同语言的人是否以相似的方式组织概念？这个问题是萨丕尔-沃尔夫假说和语言相对性争论的核心。然而，共享的基本意义并不一定意味着它们之间的关系也相同。我们使用来自两个多语言模型的词嵌入，比较了81种语言中196个基本概念之间的关系，以量化语言所表达的概念结构。跨语言对应关系在社会文化意义方面比在自然和运动意义方面更大，这种对比在各个模型和分类中都反复出现。在社会文化领域内，关系差异随着地理距离的增加而增大；关系较疏远的语言在所有领域都表现出更大的差异。这些发现表明，普遍性和相对性在概念领域是交织在一起的。它们揭示了一种解释，即共享的认知资源与语言和地方经验相互作用，并预测人类在社会文化意义方面比在自然和运动意义方面在语义判断中表现出更大的跨语言对应关系。

articles.title: Abstract Priorities, Concrete Rewards: How Stated Preferences Relate to What People Reward in AI Responses
articles.abstract: AI assistants built on large language models (LLMs) are trained on human feedback and increasingly personalized to users' stated preferences.
