Yet how closely these preferences reflect what people reward in responses remains unclear. We compare stated and revealed preferences in the public PRISM dataset, in which 1,396 participants reported how much seven response attributes mattered to them and then rated 29,347 responses from 21 LLMs. Among responses to the same prompt, features the survey never asked about, such as response length, formatting and refusal language, were at least as strongly associated with ratings as text proxies of the surveyed attributes. Whether stated priorities matched ratings depended on how attributes were measured: participants who prioritized an attribute favoured responses from models that others perceived as strong on it, but not responses that scored higher on text proxies for it. Written feedback was more telling: participants who asked for shorter answers, even in earlier conversations, gave length less weight in their ratings, and those asking for longer answers gave it more. Their relative priorities over the surveyed attributes, however, did not predict this weight. Reasons given for choices reflected perceived attributes more than measured features. Participants also differed stably in how much they weighted several concrete features, especially length, but with a median of 6 conversations per participant, these weights were estimated poorly. The largest gain from personal information in predicting held-out choices was 0.13 percentage points, compared with 1.11 for a stronger pooled model. Stated priorities thus track perceived attributes of AI responses but say little about the concrete features that ratings reward, a distinction that matters for preference elicitation and AI personalization.
articles.comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 30 tables. Code and data are available from the authors upon request
articles.titleCn: 摘要优先，具体回报：陈述偏好如何关联人们奖励的AI响应
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的AI助手通过人类反馈进行训练，并且越来越根据用户的明确偏好进行个性化。然而，这些偏好与人们在回应中实际奖励的内容之间的关联程度尚不明确。我们在公开的PRISM数据集上比较了用户的明确偏好和实际偏好，在该数据集中，1,396名参与者报告了他们认为七个回应属性的重要性，并评估了来自21个LLM的29,347个回应。在针对相同提示的回应中，调查从未询问过的特征，如回应长度、格式和拒绝语言，与调查中评估的属性文本代理的关联程度至少一样强。明确优先级是否与评分一致取决于属性如何被测量：优先考虑某个属性的参与者更倾向于来自其他人对该模型感知较强的回应，而不是那些在文本代理上得分更高的回应。书面反馈更具说明性：要求更短回应的参与者（即使在早期对话中）在评分时对长度赋予了较低权重，而要求更长回应的参与者则赋予了更高权重。然而，他们相对的优先级对调查中的属性并没有预测这种权重。选择给出的理由更多地反映了感知到的属性，而不是测量的特征。参与者在对几个具体特征（尤其是长度）的权重上也有稳定差异，但由于每个参与者中位数为6次对话，这些权重估计得不够准确。从个人信息中预测未包含选择的最大增益为0.13个百分点，而更强的聚合模型则为1.11个百分点。因此，明确优先级反映了AI回应的感知属性，但很少涉及评分所奖励的具体特征，这种区别对于偏好提取和AI个性化很重要。

articles.title: How Firm Are AI Models' Ethical Boundaries? A Pay-Stub Editing Test of 15 Models
articles.abstract: Can a small change in wording move an AI model from refusing a sensitive request to acting on it? We test 15 models on the same request to increase the income shown on a pay stub. Across 445 observable trials, models issue editing calls in 14.1% of cases when a loan purpose is stated, 33.1% when the purpose is omitted, and 66.2% when the change is described as fixing a printing error. Astra refuses all ten loan-purpose requests but issues calls in all ten purpose-omitted trials. Fable, Opus, and Muse Spark issue none across all three wordings; Sonnet issues some under the latter two. Response excerpts illustrate different ways of refusing, redirecting, or justifying an edit. The file is a marked test document and all tools are simulated. These results probe how boundaries behave in one setting; they do not prove an overall ethics ranking or that a harmful real-world edit succeeded.
articles.comment: 11 pages: 4 pages of main content, 1 page of references, and 6 appendix pages; 7 figures and 4 tables; ancillary data and code included
articles.titleCn: 人工智能模型的伦理边界有多稳固？一项针对15个模型的工资单编辑测试
articles.abstractCn: 一个措辞上的微小改动能否使AI模型从拒绝敏感请求转变为执行该请求？我们针对同一请求测试了15个模型，目的是提高工资单上显示的收入。在445次可观察的试验中，当贷款用途被陈述时，模型在14.1%的情况下发出编辑请求；当用途被省略时，这一比例升至33.1%；当改动被描述为修正打印错误时，则达到66.2%。Astra拒绝所有十个贷款用途请求，但在所有十个用途被省略的试验中均发出请求。Fable、Opus和Muse Spark在三种措辞下均未发出请求；Sonnet在最后两种情况下发出了一些请求。响应摘录展示了拒绝、重定向或为编辑进行辩护的不同方式。该文件是一个标记测试文档，所有工具均为模拟。这些结果探究了在特定环境下边界的行为方式；它们并未证明整体道德排名或有害的实时编辑请求成功。

articles.title: UniGuard: Multi-View Guardrail Learning for Cross-Interface Safety Generalization
articles.abstract: Guardrail models are increasingly used as safety layers for LLMs and agentic systems, but most are trained on fixed prompt or response interfaces and become unreliable when the same safety case appears as a conversation, agent trajectory, multi-agent trace, or policy-conditioned input. We propose UniGuard, a training framework that learns interface-invariant safety representations from multiple semantically aligned views of the same safety case. We also construct the UniGuard-FT dataset by transforming 1,000 public safety cases into prompt, response, multi-turn conversation, agent-trace, and multi-agent-trace views, and train UniGuard-0.6B with classification, supervised contrastive learning, and asymmetric confidence calibration losses. Across unseen-interface benchmarks ATBench, PolicyGuardBench, and DynaBench, UniGuard-0.6B improves over its pretrained guardrail by 45.12 F1 points on average and reduces expected calibration error by 35.41 points, while remaining competitive with much larger guardrails such as Claude-Sonnet-4.5 and GPT-5.2 - despite being a 0.6B model and trained only with synthetic data.
articles.titleCn: UniGuard：用于跨界面安全泛化的多视图护栏学习
articles.abstractCn: 防护栏模型越来越多地被用作大型语言模型和智能体系统的安全层，但大多数模型都是在固定的提示或响应接口上训练的，当相同的安全案例以对话、智能体轨迹、多智能体轨迹或策略条件输入的形式出现时，它们会变得不可靠。我们提出了UniGuard，这是一个训练框架，它从同一安全案例的多个语义对齐视图中学习接口不变的安全表示。我们还通过将1,000个公共安全案例转换为提示、响应、多轮对话、智能体轨迹和多智能体轨迹视图，构建了UniGuard-FT数据集，并使用分类、监督对比学习和非对称置信度校准损失训练了UniGuard-0.6B。在未见过接口基准测试ATBench、PolicyGuardBench和DynaBench中，UniGuard-0.6B平均比其预训练的防护栏提高了45.12个F1分数点，并将预期校准误差降低了35.41点，同时在与Claude-Sonnet-4.5和GPT-5.2等更大的防护栏保持竞争力——尽管它是一个0.6B模型，并且仅使用合成数据进行训练。

articles.title: Meaning Contracts: Local Semantic Geometry in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: This paper studies the local geometry of semantic meaning in large language models. Current representation analyses ask whether meanings are close in embedding space, or whether linear probes separate semantic classes, but they do not characterize the within-concept local geometry: what is invariant across realizations of a single semantic factor, what varies, and what changes when meaning is refined. This paper characterizes that geometry through two controlled probes evaluated on four architecturally diverse decoder-only LLMs (Gemma 4, Llama 3.2, Qwen 2.5, Pythia). A cross-lingual probe uses language as a perturbation to separate exact meaning matches, same-factor realizations, nearby concepts, and out-of-domain contrasts. A refinement probe separates specificity-bearing semantic narrowing from high-probability attributive elaboration and adversarial controls; both probes are validated by blind human judgments. Four findings recur across all models: under mean pooling, once dominant variance directions are removed, sentence pairs order by semantic relatedness (same factor, then same domain, then different domain) without overlap over a band of layers; semantic factors organize around an invariant core surrounded by structured realization-specific variation; refinement produces directed displacement into tighter neighborhoods, including against controls built on the same base noun; and sentence-level and token-local readouts expose complementary geometry (volume contraction at the sentence level, sharper anisotropic endpoints at token-local readout). We interpret these results as evidence that LLM semantics are organized as local anisotropic neighborhoods in which meaning contracts under refinement.
articles.titleCn: 意义合同：大型语言模型中的局部语义几何
articles.abstractCn: 本文研究了大型语言模型中语义意义的局部几何结构。当前的表征分析主要关注语义在嵌入空间中的接近程度，或线性探针能否区分语义类别，但它们并未刻画同一语义因素的内部概念局部几何特征：哪些特征在单一语义因素的实现中保持不变，哪些特征会变化，以及当语义被细化时会发生什么变化。本文通过在四个架构各异的解码器-only大型语言模型（Gemma 4、Llama 3.2、Qwen 2.5、Pythia）上进行的两种受控探针来刻画这种几何结构。一种跨语言探针利用语言作为扰动，以分离精确意义匹配、同一因素实现、邻近概念和领域外对比。一种细化探针则分离出带有特定性的语义细化与高概率的属性性展开及对抗性控制；这两种探针均通过盲法人类判断验证。所有模型中均出现四个重复发现：在均值池化下，一旦移除主导的方差方向，句子对的顺序按语义相关性排列（同一因素、同一领域、不同领域），且在多个层之间无重叠；语义因素围绕一个不变核心组织，周围是结构化的实现特定变化；细化导致向更紧密邻域的定向位移，包括针对基于同一基础名词构建的对照；句子级和词元局部读数揭示了互补的几何结构（句子级的体积收缩，词元局部读数的更锐利各向异性端点）。我们将这些结果解释为证据，表明大型语言模型的语义组织为局部各向异性邻域，其中意义在细化过程中收缩。

articles.title: ULME: Predictive Coupling for Mutually Reinforcing Embedding and Language Modeling
articles.abstract: Text embedding and text generation are two of the most useful capabilities of modern large language models, yet they are typically provided by separate specialized models (an embedder and a generator) trained with incompatible objectives and deployed side by side in retrieval-augmented generation and agent systems. Recent unified embedding-generation models such as GritLM share parameters between the two capabilities, but they either switch attention regimes between modes or optimize embedding and language modeling as parallel objectives that never supervise each other. We argue that these designs are only partially unified: the two capabilities coexist on the same weights, but do not shape each other. We propose ULME, a post-training framework that unifies embedding and language modeling on a causal decoder-only LLM through predictive coupling. ULME inserts a chain of learnable slots between the query and the answer, reads a semantic embedding and a reasoning embedding from two designated slots, and trains three objectives on a shared causal backbone: a contrastive loss anchoring the semantic slot to document representations, a language-modeling loss supervising answer generation, and a stop-gradient predictive loss that aligns the reasoning slot with a pooled summary of the answer, so that generation actively shapes what the embedding encodes. Across two model families (Qwen2.5, Qwen3) and eight scales spanning 0.5B-8B parameters, a single ULME checkpoint improves MTEB by 3.3-4.1 points over the strongest open-source baseline, tightens BRIGHT and AdvBench-IR simultaneously, and remains on par with a generation-only fine-tune on standard accuracy benchmarks (MMLU, GSM8K, MMLU-Pro, HumanEval), demonstrating that genuine unification yields mutually reinforcing rather than merely coexisting capabilities.
articles.titleCn: ULME：相互增强嵌入与语言模型的预测耦合
articles.abstractCn: 文本嵌入和文本生成是现代大型语言模型的两大核心能力，但它们通常由分别训练、目标不兼容的专用模型（嵌入器与生成器）提供，并在检索增强生成和智能体系统中并行部署。近期如GritLM的统一嵌入-生成模型虽然共享参数，但它们或是在不同模式下切换注意力机制，或是将嵌入和语言建模作为并行优化目标而彼此缺乏监督。我们认为这些设计只是部分统一：两种能力共享同一权重，但并未相互塑造。我们提出ULME，这是一种通过预测耦合在因果解码器式LLM上统一嵌入和语言建模的离线训练框架。ULME在查询与答案之间插入一系列可学习插槽，从指定插槽中读取语义嵌入和推理嵌入，并在共享的因果主干上训练三个目标：一个对比损失将语义插槽锚定到文档表示，一个语言建模损失监督答案生成，以及一个停止梯度预测损失使推理插槽与答案的汇总表示对齐，从而让生成过程主动塑造嵌入所编码的内容。在两个模型家族（Qwen2.5、Qwen3）和跨越0.5B-8B参数的八个规模上，单个ULME检查点使MTEB指标比最强的开源基线提升3.3-4.1分，同时提升了BRIGHT和AdvBench-IR表现，并在标准准确率基准（MMLU、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro、HumanEval）上与纯生成微调表现相当，证明真正的统一能产生相互促进而非简单共存的能力。

articles.title: Disentangling Robustness and Sycophancy in Multilingual LLMs
articles.abstract: When a multilingual LLM agrees with a user's false premise, is it being sycophantic, or does it simply not know better in that language? Current research does not distinguish these cases: they record only whether the model agreed, not why. We introduce the SC-matrix, that crosses a model's competence (whether it answers correctly under no pressure) with its sycophancy (whether it maintains that answer under pressure). Our results show that (1) identical aggregate sycophancy rates can mask different failure compositions, (2) high competence in a language does not always protect against sycophancy, and (3) reasoning-oriented mitigations outperform directive-based strategies. We find that multilingual sycophancy is not a single phenomenon but a composite of different failures that require distinct diagnosis.
articles.titleCn: 在多语言大型语言模型中解析鲁棒性与谄媚性
articles.abstractCn: 当一个多语言大型语言模型同意用户的错误前提时，它是谄媚，还是仅仅在该语言上不知道该怎么办？当前的研究无法区分这些情况：它们只记录模型是否同意，而不记录原因。我们引入了SC矩阵，它将模型的胜任力（在无压力情况下是否回答正确）与其谄媚性（在压力下是否坚持该答案）进行交叉分析。我们的结果表明：(1) 相同的总体谄媚率可能掩盖不同的失败构成，(2) 在某一语言上的高胜任力并不总是能防止谄媚，(3) 以推理为导向的缓解措施优于基于指令的策略。我们发现，多语言谄媚并非单一现象，而是由不同失败构成的复合体，需要不同的诊断方法。

articles.title: From Clinical Judgment to Checkable Rules: Clinician-Led Guardrails for Mental-Health Chatbots
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in mental-health contexts can be evaluated for safety failures, but the resulting judgments are often difficult to inspect or explain. Common approaches to improving safety rely on prompt engineering, LLM-as-a-Judge, and Constitutional AI. In this work, we describe a clinician-led alternative in which two clinicians define, finalize, and adjudicate the four safety checks of a rule base, which is formally verified for internal consistency and applied as a guardrail over LLM outputs. Here and in the title, clinician-led refers to this rule base, not to the fact extractor or the uncertainty default, which are ours. Every verdict of the resulting verification layer is recomputable from a named rule and sixteen facts. Against an LLM judge matched in model, revision, quantization, rule text, and decoding but without the layer's computed 988/911 fact, the largest disagreement class, the satisfied-rule class, is structured: the Llama-3.3-70B judge, on its primary prompt, demands a crisis resource from 55 of the 65 replies (84.6%) that already contain one, while the same model, asked as a fact extractor, reports a recognized resource present on 54 of the 55. The verification layer never raises that demand, by construction. We report with equal prominence where this judge is stronger: fewer false crisis alarms on the one reference-scored check. We also report the measured cost (a specification revision raised block-class outcomes on held-out boundary prompts of an over-refusal benchmark from 6.0% to 16.0%, chiefly by changing fact extraction), the clinicians' decision to keep our uncertainty default, and the analysis of the result. The contribution is not a safer verdict. It is a guardrail whose disagreements with the judge localize to named rules and facts and whose measured costs trace to named facts and the uncertainty default.
articles.titleCn: 从临床判断到可核查规则：由临床医生主导的用于心理健康聊天机器人的安全护栏
articles.abstractCn: 在心理健康领域部署的大型语言模型（LLMs）可以进行安全失效评估，但评估结果往往难以检查或解释。改进安全性的常用方法依赖于提示工程、LLM作为裁判以及宪法人工智能。在这项工作中，我们描述了一种由临床医生主导的替代方案，其中两位临床医生定义、最终确定并裁决规则库的四个安全检查，该规则库经过形式化验证以确保内部一致性，并作为护栏应用于LLM输出。在此以及标题中，临床医生主导指的是该规则库，而不是事实提取器或不确定性默认值，后者是我们的。结果验证层的每一项裁决都可以从一条命名规则和十六条事实中重新计算得出。与在模型、修订、量化、规则文本和解码方面匹配但缺少层计算出的988/911事实的LLM裁判相比，最大的分歧类别、满足规则类别结构如下：Llama-3.3-70B裁判在其主要提示下，要求55条回复中的45条（84.6%）已经包含危机资源，而同一模型作为事实提取器时，报告在55条回复中有54条存在已识别资源。按设计，验证层从未提出这种要求。我们同等突出地报告了这位裁判更强的方面：在一条参考评分检查上产生的假危机警报更少。我们还报告了测量的成本（一项规范修订使超拒绝基准在保留的边界提示上产生的块类结果从6.0%上升到16.0%，主要通过改变事实提取），临床医生决定保留我们的不确定性默认值，以及结果分析。这项贡献不是更安全的裁决，而是一个护栏，其与裁判的分歧局限于命名规则和事实，并且其测量的成本可追溯至命名事实和不确定性默认值。

articles.title: Direct cueing of word identity through word duration: evidence from Mandarin homophones
articles.abstract: While there is increasing evidence that words are stored in the mental lexicon with some phonetic detail, there are open questions about exactly which phonetic details are stored and whether they are functionally relevant for spoken word recognition. Word-level phonetic cues, such as word duration, provide an appropriate test case. Across languages, including Mandarin Chinese, high frequency words are shorter than low frequency words. Using a homophone ordering task, we investigate whether differences in word duration impact word recognition. Mandarin Chinese was examined since it has abundant disyllabic homophones. Our results indicate that participants were able to use word duration to recognize the order of homophone pairs, selected to vary in lexical frequency. Both with high noise levels and when no other cues were available, participants mapped the shorter duration auditory stimulus to the higher frequency word. The results provide evidence that word duration can directly cue the identity of words, suggesting that it may be a phonetic detail incorporated into the lexical representation. We discuss this direct cueing account alongside alternative accounts of how word duration may modulate word recognition.
articles.titleCn: 通过单词时长直接提示单词身份：来自普通话同音异义词的证据
articles.abstractCn: 尽管越来越多的证据表明单词以某种语音细节的形式存储在心理词汇中，但关于具体哪些语音细节被存储以及它们是否对口语单词识别具有功能相关性，仍存在一些悬而未决的问题。单词级别的语音线索，如单词时长，提供了一个合适的检验案例。跨语言研究，包括普通话，发现高频词的时长通常短于低频词。我们使用同音词排序任务来探究单词时长差异是否会影响单词识别。选择普通话进行考察，因为它拥有丰富的双音节同音词。我们的结果表明，参与者能够利用单词时长来识别同音词对的顺序，而这些同音词对在词汇频率上有所差异。在噪音水平较高以及没有其他线索可用的情况下，参与者将时长较短的声音刺激映射到高频词上。这些结果提供了证据，表明单词时长可以直接提示单词的识别，暗示它可能是被整合到词汇表征中的语音细节。我们讨论了这种直接提示解释，以及其他关于单词时长如何调节单词识别的解释。

articles.title: Scaling Laws for Safety Probes
articles.abstract: Safety probes trained on a model's activations are a standard tool for monitoring language models in real time. Each time a new model is released or a new harm area needs to be monitored, the probe must be retrained, which requires new labels and a choice of probe architecture. Yet neither the model nor the labels tell us in advance how well the resulting probe will perform. Finding out requires training and comparing many probe configurations. In this paper, we ask whether probe performance can instead be predicted in advance from model size and the number of labels. Existing safety datasets are insufficient for this, as they are either limited in scale or already saturated. We therefore construct six new safety datasets of sufficient size and difficulty. On these datasets, we train two probe architectures on 20 base models from five model families, with 32 to $10^{6}$ labels for each model. We measure performance using probe error, defined as 1 - AUROC, where lower values are better. We find that probe error follows two simple scaling laws. First, the lowest probe error a model can reach falls as a power law in its size. Second, probe error decreases towards its floor as the number of examples increases; the slope increases as the target model size increases. Both laws hold across tasks, model families and probe architectures, and only their fitted constants differ. When fitted on the smallest models of a family, the laws predict the error of the next larger model to within 0.02 in 72% of cases. They also identify whether more labels or a larger model is the cheaper way to reach a target error in 73% of cases. Finally, they choose the probe architecture with an extra error of only 0.006 on average when they pick the worse one. These laws allow safety researchers to determine how to create the best probe for any given model and label budget.
articles.titleCn: 安全探针的缩放定律
articles.abstractCn: 针对模型激活的安全探针是实时监控语言模型的常用工具。每次发布新模型或需要监控新的危害领域时，探针都必须重新训练，这需要新的标签和探针架构的选择。然而，模型和标签都无法提前告知我们最终探针的性能如何。要了解这一点，需要训练和比较许多探针配置。在本文中，我们探讨了是否可以根据模型大小和标签数量来预测探针性能。现有的安全数据集不足以支持这一目标，因为它们要么规模有限，要么已经饱和。因此，我们构建了六个规模足够且难度适宜的新安全数据集。在这些数据集上，我们针对五个模型家族的20个基础模型训练了两种探针架构，每个模型的标签数量从32到10^6不等。我们使用探针误差来衡量性能，定义为1 - AUROC，其中较低值表示更好。我们发现探针误差遵循两个简单的缩放规律。首先，模型能达到的最低探针误差与其大小呈幂律关系。其次，随着样本数量的增加，探针误差会逐渐降低至其下限；当目标模型大小增加时，斜率也会增加。这两种规律适用于各种任务、模型家族和探针架构，只有其拟合常数不同。当在家族中最小的模型上拟合这些规律时，它们能以72%的准确度预测下一个较大模型的误差在0.02以内。它们还能在73%的情况下判断是增加更多标签还是扩大模型规模更能以目标误差达成目标。最后，当选择较差的探针架构时，这些规律平均仅增加0.006的误差。这些规律使安全研究人员能够确定如何为给定的模型和标签预算创建最佳探针。

articles.title: WikiOriginQA: Automated Construction of a QA Dataset with Knowledge Origins for Analyzing Cultural Bias
articles.abstract: Existing datasets on cultural knowledge have been typically created by human annotators familiar with each culture. However, the process requires considerable human effort, presenting a significant challenge to scalability. To address this challenge, we introduce WikiOriginQA, a QA dataset automatically constructed by objectively representing the origins of knowledge through the creation dates of different Wikipedia language editions. Experimental results with the created dataset confirm that LLM performance tends to be biased toward Anglophone cultures. Furthermore, the results suggest the importance of knowledge propagation into the Anglosphere. These findings demonstrate the validity of our automated approach, enabling cultural bias evaluations with superior scalability across diverse languages without extensive manual annotation.
articles.comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (9 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables)
articles.titleCn: WikiOriginQA：基于知识来源的自动化QA数据集构建与分析文化偏见
articles.abstractCn: 现有的文化知识数据集通常由熟悉每种文化的标注人员创建。然而，该过程需要大量的人力投入，给可扩展性带来了重大挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了WikiOriginQA，这是一个通过不同维基百科语言版本的创建日期客观地表示知识起源而自动构建的问答数据集。使用创建的数据集进行的实验结果证实，大型语言模型的性能往往倾向于盎格鲁文化。此外，结果还表明了知识向盎格鲁语区的传播的重要性。这些发现证明了我们自动化方法的可行性，能够在无需大量人工标注的情况下，对多种语言进行具有更高可扩展性的文化偏差评估。

articles.title: Spectral Smoothing and Spiking Perturbations Reconfigure Capability Profiles and Selective Task Performance in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Singular-value spectra encode important structure in transformer feed-forward projections, yet their causal role in downstream behavior remains underexplored. We study post-hoc spectral smoothing and spiking interventions on the up_proj and down_proj matrices. Positive perturbation stretches deviations from the geometric mean, making large singular values larger and small ones smaller (spiking), and vice versa. The intervention preserves singular vectors and the geometric mean of the singular values. Across five open Llama and Qwen instruction models, we evaluate the perturbed systems on capability-labeled subtasks, standard and chain-of-thought reasoning benchmarks, judge-scored truthfulness, hallucination, and safety tasks, and TRAIT personality probes. To interpret score shifts, we fit responses in a three-dimensional capability basis consisting of factual knowledge, language understanding, and deductive reasoning. The induced changes suggest structured rather than purely random sensitivity: large positive perturbations more reliably suppress language and deductive responses, moderate negative perturbations can sometimes improve factual or task-local performance on the evaluated grids, and sensitivity varies strongly by model family, benchmark module, and underlying layerwise spectral inequality. These results position spectral perturbation as a lightweight intervention for probing how capabilities are organized and traded off in large language models.
articles.titleCn: 频谱平滑和尖峰扰动重塑大型语言模型的能力配置文件和选择性任务性能
articles.abstractCn: 奇异值谱在Transformer前馈投影中编码了重要结构，但它们在下游行为中的因果作用尚未得到充分探索。我们研究了后处理谱平滑和尖峰干预对up_proj和down_proj矩阵的影响。正扰动会拉大偏离几何平均值的程度，使大的奇异值更大而小的奇异值更小（尖峰），反之亦然。干预保留了奇异向量和奇异值的几何平均值。在五个公开的Llama和Qwen指令模型中，我们在能力标签子任务、标准推理和思维链推理基准、评分员评分的真实性、幻觉和安全任务以及TRAIT人格探针上评估了扰动系统。为了解释分数变化，我们将响应拟合在一个由事实知识、语言理解和演绎推理组成的三维能力基上。诱导的变化表明敏感性并非完全随机，而是具有结构：大的正扰动更可靠地抑制语言和演绎响应，中等的负扰动有时可以提高评估网格上的事实或任务局部性能，并且敏感性因模型系列、基准模块和底层逐层谱不等而差异很大。这些结果将谱扰动定位为一种轻量级干预手段，用于探究大型语言模型中能力是如何组织和权衡的。

articles.title: Compiling Autoregressive LLM Control into Policy-Exact Parallel Inference for Hierarchical RAG
articles.abstract: Large language models increasingly act as controllers in structured decision pipelines, yet their decisions are still executed by autoregressive text decoding. Hierarchical RAG is one such setting: at each frontier of a document tree, an LLM commits to $b$ of $k$ sections under an input-dependent action grammar, executed as either failure-prone free-form JSON or reliable but strictly serial grammar-constrained generation. We show that this serialization is unnecessary for bounded-horizon control: the reachable future forms a shallow action-prefix tree, which we compile --- one root prefill plus one tree-causal probe evaluate every prefix-conditioned action distribution with serial decoding's tokens, positions, and causal ancestry. A prefix-state lemma makes compiled control policy-exact in exact arithmetic: the same policy with a two-forward critical path and zero output tokens. One further probe pass certifies the exact order-marginalized MAP set. Across four document-disjoint splits and two scales on the primary MetaX device, compiled control matches the serial policy on $84$--$89\%$ of questions --- every instrumented divergence a floating-point near-tie --- and cuts control latency by $35$--$47\%$ versus token-wise serial decoding and $6$--$7\%$ versus an idealized chunked engine; an H800 repetition preserves the ordering.
articles.titleCn: 将自回归LLM控制编译为分层RAG的精确策略并行推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地作为结构化决策流程中的控制器，但它们的决策仍由自回归文本解码执行。分层RAG就是这样一种场景：在文档树的每个前沿，一个LLM在输入相关的动作语法下，承诺执行$k$个部分中的$b$个，这些部分以易出错的自由形式JSON或可靠但严格序列的语法约束生成执行。我们表明，对于有界视野控制，这种序列化是不必要的：可达的未来形成一个浅层动作前缀树，我们将其编译——一个根预填充加上一个树因果探测，每个前缀条件下的动作分布都用序列解码的标记、位置和因果祖先进行评估。一个前缀状态引理使编译的控制策略在精确算术中完全精确：具有两个前向关键路径和零输出标记的相同策略。进一步的探测遍历验证了精确的顺序边际化MAP集。在四个文档不连续的分割和主要MetaX设备上的两个尺度上，编译的控制匹配序列策略在$84$--$89\%$的问题上——每个仪器化的偏差都是浮点近似平局——并将控制延迟与标记级序列解码相比降低了$35$--$47\%$，与理想化的分块引擎相比降低了$6$--$7\%$；一个H800重复保持了顺序。

articles.title: Group Relative Policy Optimisation Improves Multilingual Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
articles.abstract: Autoregressive encoder-decoder speech recognition models trained with teacher forcing can suffer from exposure bias, limiting their ability to recover from their own prediction errors at inference time. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves speech recognition in major languages with LLM-based models. We extend this line of work to smaller, non-LLM encoder-decoder ASR models, using Whisper-large-v3 as a case study across 51 African languages. The benefits of this approach are most pronounced when training data is scarce or when input audio is noisy or degraded. Our resulting model, SunflowerASR, achieves the best published macro-averaged WER on the AfriVox-v2 (0.227) and SimbaBench (0.372) benchmarks, and is publicly available.
articles.titleCn: 组相对策略优化提升了低资源语言的多语言语音识别
articles.abstractCn: 使用教师强制训练的自回归编码器-解码器语音识别模型可能存在暴露偏差，限制了它们在推理时从自身预测错误中恢复的能力。近期研究表明，采用基于大型语言模型（LLM）的模型并结合相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习能够提升主要语言的语音识别效果。我们在此基础上扩展了这项工作，将其应用于规模较小、非LLM的编码器-解码器语音识别（ASR）模型，并以Whisper-large-v3为例，在51种非洲语言中进行了研究。当训练数据稀缺或输入音频存在噪声或退化时，该方法的优势尤为明显。我们最终提出的模型SunflowerASR，在AfriVox-v2（0.227）和SimbaBench（0.372）基准测试中取得了已发表的宏观平均词错误率（WER）最佳成绩，并且已公开发布。

articles.title: What the Specification Did Not Say: Specification-Oracle Gaps in Test-Graded Coding-Agent Benchmarks
articles.abstract: Coding-agent benchmarks often describe a task in natural language but grade it with tests taken from the upstream project. Passing those tests can require information the description never states: a constant's name, a module path, an exact message. We call this a specification-oracle gap: where it exists, a benchmark also measures whether an agent reproduces upstream implementation details. We formalise the gap, including the inconsistencies that chains of dependent tasks add, and build a static audit for five languages that classifies every name-, path- and literal-level dependency of every scored test (held-out precision 89.2%, recall 92.9%). On SWE-Milestone (98 graded milestones, 35 published runs), 25 milestones contain a test that depends on an unstated, non-inferable name or path. Build units with such a dependency fail in 80.6% of runs, against 48.4% for comparable units without one, and withholding a single hidden name from the reference stops its unit's tests from compiling in 126 of 128 cases. The leaderboard's ranking is robust to removing the affected tests, but they shift scores within repositories and favour agents that reproduce upstream names. Across four further benchmarks, prevalence appears to follow construction: a third or more of the tasks are affected where specifications are release notes or LLM summaries, almost none where tasks are screened or written for their tests; how much a gap costs depends on how the harness grades. We release the audit, corrected filter lists and specification addenda.
articles.titleCn: 规格说明未说明的内容：测试评级编码代理基准中的规格说明-预言机差距
articles.abstractCn: 代码代理基准测试通常用自然语言描述任务，但用上游项目的测试来评分。通过这些测试可能需要描述中从未提及的信息：常量的名称、模块路径、确切的消息。我们称之为规范-预言机差距：当存在这种差距时，基准测试还会衡量代理是否复现了上游实现细节。我们形式化了这个差距，包括依赖任务链引入的不一致性，并构建了一个针对五种语言的静态审计，该审计分类了每个评分测试的名称级、路径级和字面量级依赖（保留精度89.2%，召回率92.9%）。在SWE-Milestone（98个评分里程碑，35个已发布运行）中，25个里程碑包含一个依赖于未声明、不可推断的名称或路径的测试。具有此类依赖的构建单元在80.6%的运行中失败，而没有此类依赖的可比单元仅为48.4%，并且从参考中隐藏一个名称会导致其单元测试在128个案例中的126个案例无法编译。排行榜的排名在移除受影响的测试后仍然稳健，但这些测试会改变存储库内的分数，并倾向于复现上游名称的代理。在另外四个基准测试中，普遍性似乎遵循构建方式：当规范是发布说明或LLM摘要时，三分之一或更多的任务受影响，而当任务是为测试而筛选或编写时，几乎不受影响；差距的成本取决于测试框架的评分方式。我们发布了审计、修正的过滤器列表和规范补充说明。

articles.title: The Fusion Tax: A Diagnostic Analysis of When Hybrid Retrieval Hurts
articles.abstract: Hybrid retrieval, which fuses a sparse lexical retriever with a dense neural one, is widely recommended in the software documentation surveyed in September 2026, usually with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), on the strength of aggregate gains. We ask what fusion costs on individual queries, treating "do not fuse" as a first-class outcome, in the setting in which hybrid retrieval is deployed: a standard Anserini BM25, five dense encoders spanning 22M-596M parameters and three model generations, a learned-sparse (SPLADE) alternative, and a cross-encoder second stage, on seven BEIR datasets and three fusion functions. Even the best method, dense-weighted score interpolation, ranks relevant documents below the better of its two components on 13-48% of queries and below the deployable dense-only retriever on 8-21% (14-48% and 11-25% at a weight selected under leave-one-corpus-out validation), while beating dense-only in aggregate on every corpus with the primary encoder; the downside is significant under loss-averse risk-sensitive evaluation on six of the seven corpora. We call this loss the fusion tax. It is mostly a ranking effect that preserves recall in aggregate, it is most likely on the queries that only one retriever covers, and it persists across the encoder ladder and the SPLADE substitution. RRF carries the higher tax wherever the dense retriever is clearly stronger and only beats dense-only where the two components are balanced. Fusion failure is weakly predictable within a corpus but transfers unreliably across corpora, because the features that predict it change sign with the sparse-dense balance. A cross-encoder recovers part of the tax only where it is itself reliable. We distill these findings into guidance that keys the fusion decision to the measured sparse-dense balance of the target corpus.
articles.titleCn: 融合税：混合检索何时有害的诊断分析
articles.abstractCn: 混合检索，即将稀疏词汇检索器与密集神经网络检索器融合，在2026年9月调查的软件文档中被广泛推荐，通常使用互惠排名融合（RRF），基于综合收益的优势。我们探讨在混合检索部署环境中，单个查询上的融合成本，将“不融合”视为一等结果：标准Anserini BM25、五个参数范围从2200万到5960万的密集编码器、一个学习稀疏（SPLADE）替代方案，以及一个交叉编码器第二阶段，在七个BEIR数据集和三种融合函数上。即使最佳方法——密集加权分数插值——在13-48%的查询中将相关文档排在其两个组件中较好者之下，并在8-21%（在留一语料库外验证选择的权重下为14-48%和11-25%）的查询中将相关文档排在可部署的仅密集检索器之下，尽管在所有语料库中，使用主要编码器时，它在综合上优于仅密集检索器；缺点是在六个语料库中，在规避损失的风险敏感评估下非常显著。我们将这种损失称为融合税。这主要是一种排名效应，它在综合上保留了召回率，最可能出现在只有一个检索器覆盖的查询上，并且贯穿编码器阶梯和SPLADE替代方案。RRF在密集检索器明显更强的地方承担更高的税，并且只有在两个组件平衡时才优于仅密集检索器。融合失败在语料库内可以弱预测，但在语料库间不可靠转移，因为预测它的特征会随着稀疏-密集平衡而改变符号。交叉编码器只在它本身可靠时才能恢复部分融合税。我们将这些发现提炼为指导方针，将融合决策的关键基于目标语料库的稀疏-密集平衡测量值。

articles.title: TT-SAX: A Two-Track Time Series Symbolization for Natural Language Shape Querying
articles.abstract: Natural language querying for time series databases aims to let users find what they need in long histories of data by asking in plain language. Shape queries ask how a series moves. They are the main challenge of this task. Recent work makes them feasible by using symbolization as a bridge between the query and the long history. However, existing symbolizations were designed for compression, similarity indexing, or classification. What a symbolization should provide for natural language querying has not been systematically studied. We therefore examine the definitions of six classical symbolizations against this task and identify three limitations. (1) Direction is missing from the string, (2) direction is measured at too small a scale, and (3) the letters are arbitrary. Three design principles follow. We follow these principles and make a minimal redesign of SAX called TT-SAX (two-track SAX). The level letters stay. Each segment gains a trend letter. It is measured across neighboring segments rather than inside one, and graded to match the adjectives that queries use. We conduct extensive experiments on the public NLQTSBench benchmark, comparing TT-SAX with the six classical symbolizations across six LLMs. TT-SAX outperforms all six on shape queries, and ablations trace its gains back to the three limitations one by one. This paper is the first systematic study of time series symbolization with natural language querying as the design goal. It provides a foundation for future research on this task. Our code is available at https://github.com/Atlamtiz/tt-sax.

articles.titleCn: TT-SAX：一种用于自然语言形状查询的双轨时间序列符号化方法
articles.abstractCn: 时间序列数据库的自然语言查询旨在让用户通过日常语言在漫长数据历史中找到所需信息。形状查询询问序列如何变化，是这项任务的主要挑战。近期研究通过使用符号化作为查询与漫长历史之间的桥梁，使形状查询变得可行。然而，现有的符号化设计用于压缩、相似性索引或分类。符号化在自然语言查询中应提供什么尚未得到系统研究。因此，我们针对此任务检验了六种经典符号化的定义，并发现了三个局限性。(1) 字符串中缺少方向信息，(2) 方向是在过于细小的尺度上测量的，(3) 字母是任意的。由此衍生出三条设计原则。我们遵循这些原则，对SAX进行最小化重新设计，称为TT-SAX（双轨SAX）。保留等级字母，每个片段增加一个趋势字母。趋势是在相邻片段之间而非单个片段内部测量的，并分级以匹配查询使用的形容词。我们在公共NLQTSBench基准上进行了大量实验，比较TT-SAX与六种经典符号化在六个大型语言模型上的表现。TT-SAX在形状查询上优于所有六种符号化，且消融实验将其收益逐一追溯到三个局限性。本文首次系统地研究了以自然语言查询为目标的时间序列符号化，为未来该任务的研究提供了基础。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Atlamtiz/tt-sax获取。

articles.title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
articles.abstract: LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content. We present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system. First, nine role-specialised agents decide jointly: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports, from which a Portfolio Manager sets target positions that a protected Risk Manager audits. Second, a seven-layer shared memory, assembled by code from the system's own record, gives each decision its position context, the market narrative, calibration and the agent's past decisions. Third, the system improves itself by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes the grades into memory, and each quarter a reflector proposes prompt learnings that a deterministic gate applies reversibly and replay of recorded inputs verifies. All three operate around an invariant core of order arithmetic, risk rules and discipline-agent prompts that no self-edit can reach. In a five-month live deployment (102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls), the system contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss; in replay of its recorded inputs, a single model given the same raw data traded more and lost 1.35 points against the market over five days where the joint design showed no significant loss, and no injected instruction was followed; and a 2015-2026 backtest shows the core alone lowering the maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies. The reflector traced the dominant failure to its root cause, and the gate applied a learning that the agent adopted on trigger evenings and on no control evening. Code: https://github.com/yebof/quant-agent
articles.titleCn: 自主投资的自洽进化：一个具有不变核心的多智能体LLM系统
articles.abstractCn: 在实时网络数据上行动的大型语言模型代理必须结合异构证据，记住自己已完成的行动，并通过结果改进自身而不削弱自身的安全防护。我们在自主投资领域研究这一问题，其中每项行动都是不可逆转的，且基于不可信的网络内容。我们提出了Steward，一个通过类型系统划定自我进化边界的多代理LLM系统。首先，九个角色专业化的代理共同决策：四个分析师阅读新闻源、SEC文件、宏观经济序列和市场数据，并发出类型化报告，投资组合经理根据这些报告设定目标头寸，受保护的风险管理员对这些头寸进行审核。其次，一个由系统自身记录代码组装的七层共享内存，为每个决策提供位置背景、市场叙事、校准和代理的过去决策。第三，系统通过审查进行自我改进：代码每晚对每笔交易和预测进行评分，并将评分写入内存，每个季度一个反思器提出提示学习，一个确定性门控可逆地应用这些学习，记录输入的回放验证。这三者都围绕一个不变的核心运行，该核心包括算术顺序、风险规则和纪律代理提示，任何自我编辑都无法触及。在为期五个月的实时部署（102个交易日，1,632次LLM调用）中，系统经历了24.6%的行业回撤，最终亏损0.3%；在记录输入的回放中，单个模型在相同原始数据下交易更频繁，五天内对市场亏损1.35点，而联合设计未出现显著亏损，且未遵循任何注入指令；2015-2026年的回测显示，仅核心部分就能在所有50种随机入场策略下降低最大回撤。反思器追踪了主要失败的根本原因，门控应用了代理在触发夜晚而非控制夜晚采用的学习。代码：https://github.com/yebof/quant-agent
